en: All the passengers are now aboard, so the plane can take off.
zh: 所有乘客都已登機，飛機可以起飛了。

zh: 天氣預報很準確，整個下午真的都在下雨。

zh: 打完一場漫長的籃球賽後，我的腿開始痠痛。

zh: 艾咪每天用功讀書，終於達成了她的目標。

zh: 換大杯飲料需要額外多付五十元。

en: Many students admire the coach for his hard work and kindness.
zh: 許多學生欽佩這位教練的努力與親切。

zh: 這門高級數學課只開給熱愛數字的學生。

zh: 打籃球時，個子高是一大優勢。

zh: 這趟山上之旅對我們全家來說是一場真正的冒險。

zh: 我們在公車上看到那支新手機的廣告。

en: The doctor advised me to drink more water and sleep earlier.
zh: 醫生建議我多喝水、早點睡。

zh: 選大學之前，湯姆先和學校的輔導顧問談過。

zh: 我們買不起新車，所以還是搭公車。

en: We had dinner together and went to a movie afterward.
zh: 我們一起吃了晚餐，之後去看電影。

en: Agriculture is still very important in the south of Taiwan.
zh: 農業在台灣南部仍然非常重要。

en: The airline gave every passenger a free meal on the flight.
zh: 這家航空公司在飛機上提供每位乘客免費餐點。

zh: 這條小巷的盡頭有一家小麵店。

en: Grandma likes to put almonds in her cookies and cakes.
zh: 奶奶喜歡在餅乾和蛋糕裡加杏仁。

en: Young children often learn the alphabet by singing a song.
zh: 小孩子常常藉由唱歌來學習字母表。

en: The little boy's piano playing amazed everyone in the room.
zh: 這個小男孩的鋼琴演奏讓在場每個人都大感驚訝。

en: The ambassador came to our school to talk about his country.
zh: 這位大使來我們學校介紹他的國家。

en: Her ambition is to become a doctor and help sick children.
zh: 她的抱負是成為醫生，幫助生病的孩子。

en: When the old man fell down, someone called an ambulance right away.
zh: 老先生跌倒時，有人立刻叫了救護車。

en: The kind nurse was like an angel to the sick children.
zh: 那位親切的護士對生病的孩子們來說就像天使一樣。

en: The principal announced that school would close because of the storm.
zh: 校長宣布學校將因暴風雨而停課。

en: Ben felt anxious before his first speech in front of the class.
zh: 班在全班面前第一次演講前感到很焦慮。

en: It was raining hard, but we went to the beach anyhow.
zh: 雨下得很大，但我們無論如何還是去了海邊。

en: The two schools are only a few blocks apart.
zh: 這兩所學校只相隔幾個街區。

en: Tom apologized to his sister for breaking her new pencil box.
zh: 湯姆因為弄壞妹妹的新鉛筆盒而向她道歉。

en: The city appealed to people to use less water this summer.
zh: 市政府呼籲民眾今年夏天節約用水。

en: My parents finally approved my plan to study abroad.
zh: 我爸媽終於批准了我出國讀書的計畫。

en: Dad always wears an apron when he cooks in the kitchen.
zh: 爸爸在廚房做菜時總是穿著圍裙。

en: The guards at the bank are armed to keep everyone safe.
zh: 銀行的警衛都配有武器，以保護大家的安全。

zh: 警察逮捕了那個在我們學校附近偷腳踏車的男子。

zh: 營火結束後，地上只剩下灰色的灰燼。

zh: 請把手機放到一旁，專心聽老師說話。

zh: 學長姊協助新生找到他們的教室。

zh: 醫生的助理請我稍等幾分鐘。

zh: 湯姆以為那家店有營業，沒想到它星期一公休。

zh: 這位年輕運動員每天早上訓練三小時。

zh: 積極的態度能幫助你度過難關。

en: The bright flowers attract many bees and butterflies in spring.
zh: 鮮豔的花朵在春天吸引許多蜜蜂和蝴蝶。

zh: 這座新公園對有小孩的家庭很有吸引力。

zh: 學校話劇演出結束時，觀眾熱烈鼓掌。

zh: 你朝自動門走過去時，門就會打開。

zh: 汽車改變了人們往來各地的方式。

zh: 我們學校附近的大道兩旁有許多高大的樹。

zh: 寶寶到半夜還醒著，所以媽媽非常累。

zh: 星期天一大早，鳥叫聲喚醒了艾咪。

zh: 麗莎的畫作在學校美展中得獎。

en: Are you aware that the bus times changed this week?
zh: 你有注意到這星期公車時刻改了嗎？

zh: 那家餐廳的食物很糟糕，所以我們再也沒去過。

zh: 湯姆講了一個難笑的笑話後，現場一陣尷尬的沉默。

zh: 這張照片的背景是一座美麗的山。

zh: 早餐時，爸爸替全家人做了蛋和培根。

zh: 飯前要洗手，才能去除細菌。

zh: 傑克從腳踏車上摔下來，腿傷得很嚴重。

zh: 在機場請不要把行李丟著不管。

zh: 我們去釣魚時，爺爺用小蟲當魚餌。

zh: 熊貓一天中大部分時間都在森林裡吃竹子。

zh: 門在強風中砰的一聲關上了。

zh: 艾咪的爸爸是在台北市中心工作的銀行家。

zh: 孩子們光著腳在海灘上奔跑。

zh: 李歐累到幾乎睜不開眼睛。

zh: 農夫把牛養在一座紅色的大穀倉裡。

zh: 爺爺用一個大桶子收集雨水來澆花園。

zh: 我們把舊箱子和腳踏車放在家裡的地下室。

zh: 晴朗的週末有許多船在海灣裡航行。

zh: 莎拉用紅色和藍色的小珠子做了一條項鍊。

zh: 一道光束從小窗戶照了進來。

zh: 在故事裡，一個善良的女孩和一隻可怕的野獸成了朋友。

zh: 男孩在花園的石頭底下發現一隻黑色甲蟲。

zh: 貓正睡在廚房的桌子底下。

en: Regular exercise has many benefits for both body and mind.
zh: 規律運動對身心都有許多好處。

zh: 我們在農場摘了新鮮的莓果，馬上就吃掉了。

zh: 除了英文，凱文還會說日文和一點法文。

zh: 班打賭我們隊隔天會贏球。

zh: 這藥很苦，吃完後喝點水吧。

zh: 米亞的手指被紙割到後開始流血。

zh: 奶奶每天禱告，祈求上天保佑我們全家。

zh: 湯姆在操場上跌倒，膝蓋流血了。

en: Mom wore a white blouse and a black skirt to work.
zh: 媽媽穿著白色女用上衣和黑色裙子去上班。

zh: 艾咪敢在全校面前獨唱，真是大膽。

zh: 工人在河邊發現一顆戰爭時期留下的舊炸彈。

zh: 爸爸為我所有的漫畫書做了一個高高的書櫃。

zh: 下雨天，孩子們穿雨靴上學。

zh: 冗長的演講讓學生覺得很無聊，有些人睡著了。

zh: 上週六晚上我們和表兄弟姊妹去打保齡球。

zh: 一隻狗衝到街上時，司機猛踩煞車。

zh: 那扇舊門有一個沉重的黃銅把手，摸起來冰冰的。

zh: 這位消防員因勇敢救出一名孩童而獲獎。

zh: 雞胸肉是許多常運動的人喜愛的食物。

zh: 考試前深吸一口氣，試著保持冷靜。

en: It is hard to breathe at the top of a high mountain.
zh: 在高山頂上很難呼吸。

zh: 炎熱的下午，一陣涼爽的微風從海上吹來。

zh: 那棟舊校舍是用紅磚蓋的。

zh: 新娘在婚禮上穿著一件白色長禮服。

zh: 那場籃球賽今晚八點會在電視上轉播。

en: On Sundays, we often get up late and have brunch together.
zh: 星期天我們常常晚起，然後一起吃早午餐。

en: The children laughed as they blew bubbles in the park.
zh: 孩子們在公園裡吹泡泡，笑得很開心。

en: Please fill the bucket with water so we can wash the car.
zh: 請把水桶裝滿水，我們好洗車。

en: In spring, small green buds appear on the trees.
zh: 春天時，樹上冒出小小的綠芽。

en: Our class has a small budget for the year-end party.
zh: 我們班的期末派對預算不多。

zh: 以前台灣的農夫會在稻田裡使用水牛耕作。

en: The hotel buffet has many kinds of food, from noodles to cake.
zh: 飯店的自助餐有各式各樣的食物，從麵到蛋糕都有。

zh: 浴室的燈泡壞了，所以裡面很暗。

en: The farmer told us to stay away from the angry bull.
zh: 農夫叫我們離那頭生氣的公牛遠一點。

en: This fast train is called a bullet train because of its shape.
zh: 這種高速列車因外形像子彈，所以被稱為子彈列車。

en: Be careful not to bump your head on the low door.
zh: 小心別讓頭撞到矮門。

en: Amy bought a bunch of bananas at the market this morning.
zh: 艾咪今天早上在市場買了一串香蕉。

en: Grandma tied the old newspapers into a neat bundle.
zh: 奶奶把舊報紙整齊地綁成一捆。

en: The dog buried its bone under the tree in the yard.
zh: 那隻狗把骨頭埋在院子的樹下。

en: A small bird is hiding in the bush outside the window.
zh: 一隻小鳥躲在窗外的灌木叢裡。

en: We could hear the buzz of bees around the flowers.
zh: 我們聽得到花朵周圍蜜蜂的嗡嗡聲。

zh: 我們住在山上的一間小木屋裡。

zh: 你需要用這條傳輸線把照片從手機傳到電腦。

zh: 學生們中午一起在學校的自助餐廳吃午餐。

zh: 琳達有能力獨自完成這個專題。

en: The captain of our soccer team is the fastest runner in school.
zh: 我們足球隊的隊長是全校跑最快的人。

en: The photo captured the beautiful moment when the sun went down.
zh: 這張照片捕捉到夕陽西下的美麗瞬間。

en: Jenny wants to have a career in music after college.
zh: 珍妮大學畢業後想從事音樂方面的職業。

zh: 木匠為我們的廚房做了一張堅固的木桌。

en: Please take off your shoes before you walk on the carpet.
zh: 走上地毯前請先脫鞋。

en: The princess rode in a beautiful carriage pulled by four white horses.
zh: 公主坐在一輛由四匹白馬拉的美麗馬車裡。

en: Mom pushed the shopping cart while I picked out the fruit.
zh: 媽媽推著購物車，我負責挑水果。

en: The old man cast his net into the river early in the morning.
zh: 老人一大早就把漁網撒進河裡。

en: You can wear casual clothes to the class party on Friday.
zh: 星期五的班級派對可以穿便服。

en: The farmer has fifty cattle on his large farm.
zh: 農夫的大農場裡養了五十頭牛。

en: Bats sleep in the dark cave during the day.
zh: 蝙蝠白天在黑暗的洞穴裡睡覺。

en: Our school became the basketball champion of the city this year.
zh: 我們學校今年拿下全市籃球賽冠軍。

en: The old town has a special charm that visitors love.
zh: 這座老城鎮有一種遊客喜愛的特殊魅力。

en: Amy and her friends like to chat after school.
zh: 艾咪和朋友們喜歡在放學後聊天。

en: Grandma gently kissed the baby on the cheek.
zh: 奶奶輕輕地親了寶寶的臉頰。

en: Our cheerful neighbor always says hello with a big smile.
zh: 我們開朗的鄰居總是笑容滿面地打招呼。

en: This chocolate cake has a red cherry on top of it.
zh: 這個巧克力蛋糕上面有一顆紅櫻桃。

en: Tom felt a pain in his chest after running too fast.
zh: 湯姆跑太快之後覺得胸口痛。

en: A cold wind sent a chill through the students waiting outside.
zh: 一陣冷風讓在外面等候的學生感到一陣寒意。

en: It's chilly this morning, so take a jacket with you.
zh: 今天早上有點冷，帶件外套吧。

en: Smoke is coming out of the chimney of the old house.
zh: 煙從那棟老房子的煙囪冒出來。

en: He rested his chin on his hand and thought for a while.
zh: 他用手托著下巴，想了一會兒。

en: We ate potato chips and watched a movie at home.
zh: 我們在家邊吃洋芋片邊看電影。

en: Dad chopped the onions for the soup while Mom washed the rice.
zh: 爸爸切碎洋蔥準備煮湯，媽媽則在洗米。

zh: 抽菸對你和你身邊的人的健康都有害。

zh: 我們今晚七點在電影院前面碰面吧。

zh: 在馬戲團裡，我們看到了大象，還有一個人在走鋼索。

en: Every citizen should follow the law and help keep the city clean.
zh: 每位市民都應該守法，並幫忙維持城市整潔。

en: The old army airport is now used for civil flights.
zh: 這座舊軍用機場現在改作民航班機使用。

en: The students made small cups out of clay in art class.
zh: 學生們在美術課上用黏土做小杯子。

zh: 清潔工每天晚上在我們下班後來辦公室打掃。

zh: 她用一枚迴紋針把這幾頁夾在一起。

zh: 艾咪把新洋裝掛在臥室的衣櫥裡。

en: The parents work hard to feed and clothe their four children.
zh: 這對父母努力工作，讓四個孩子吃得飽、穿得暖。

zh: 大人們在婚禮上喝雞尾酒，小孩子則喝果汁。

zh: 在這個句子的兩個部分之間加一個逗號。

en: The school committee decided to plant more trees around the field.
zh: 學校委員會決定在操場周圍多種一些樹。

en: It is hard to communicate with someone who never listens.
zh: 和一個從來不聽別人說話的人溝通很困難。

en: In comparison with last year, this summer is much hotter.
zh: 和去年相比，今年夏天熱多了。

en: Twenty runners will compete in the race on Saturday.
zh: 有二十位跑者會在星期六的賽跑中一較高下。

en: Tom always complains about the food in the school cafeteria.
zh: 湯姆總是抱怨學校自助餐廳的食物。

en: The restaurant got many complaints about its slow service.
zh: 這家餐廳接到很多關於上菜太慢的抱怨。

en: We bought tickets for the rock concert next Saturday.
zh: 我們買了下週六搖滾音樂會的票。

en: At the end of your report, write a short conclusion.
zh: 在報告的最後寫一段簡短的結論。

en: The little girl dropped her ice cream cone on the ground.
zh: 小女孩把她的甜筒冰淇淋掉在地上了。

en: Please call the hotel to confirm our room for Friday night.
zh: 請打電話給飯店確認我們週五晚上的房間。

en: The new math rules confused many students in our class.
zh: 新的數學規則讓我們班很多學生感到困惑。

en: This bridge connects the island to the main city.
zh: 這座橋把小島和主要城市連接起來。

en: The boy fell off his bike but was still conscious.
zh: 男孩從腳踏車上摔下來，但仍然有意識。

en: Learning to play the piano well takes a considerable amount of time.
zh: 要把鋼琴彈好需要相當多的時間。

en: The constant noise from the street made it hard to sleep.
zh: 街上持續不斷的噪音讓人難以入睡。

en: Asia is the largest continent in the whole world.
zh: 亞洲是全世界最大的洲。

en: Ken lost the game controller, so we couldn't play together.
zh: 肯弄丟了遊戲控制器，所以我們沒辦法一起玩。

en: Mom cooks rice in a rice cooker every evening.
zh: 媽媽每天晚上用電鍋煮飯。

en: Fixing the old car would be too costly, so we bought a new one.
zh: 修理那輛舊車太昂貴了，所以我們買了一輛新車。

en: This T-shirt is made of soft cotton and feels nice.
zh: 這件T恤是用柔軟的棉做的，穿起來很舒服。

en: Ben has a bad cough, so he stayed home from school.
zh: 班咳嗽得很厲害，所以請假在家沒去上學。

en: In English, "apple" is countable, but "water" is not.
zh: 在英文中，「apple」是可數的，但「water」不是。

en: Our county has many beautiful beaches and farms.
zh: 我們縣有許多美麗的海灘和農場。

en: We saw a small crab hiding under a rock on the beach.
zh: 我們看到一隻小螃蟹躲在海灘的石頭底下。

en: The mother gently rocked the baby in the cradle.
zh: 媽媽輕輕搖著搖籃裡的寶寶。

en: A tall crane is lifting heavy things at the new building.
zh: 一台高大的起重機正在新大樓工地吊起重物。

en: Nobody was hurt when the two cars crashed on the bridge.
zh: 兩輛車在橋上相撞時，沒有人受傷。

en: The baby can crawl across the room but cannot walk yet.
zh: 寶寶會爬過整個房間，但還不會走路。

en: Amy is very creative and always has new ideas for our project.
zh: 艾咪很有創意，總是為我們的專題提出新點子。

en: The creator of this cartoon spent five years drawing it.
zh: 這部卡通的創作者花了五年時間畫它。

en: Many strange creatures live at the bottom of the sea.
zh: 許多奇特的生物住在海底。

en: Our team won, but most of the credit goes to Ben.
zh: 我們隊贏了，但大部分的功勞要歸給班。

en: The ship's crew worked day and night during the storm.
zh: 船上的全體船員在暴風雨中日夜工作。

en: At night, we could hear crickets singing in the grass.
zh: 晚上我們可以聽到草叢裡蟋蟀的叫聲。

en: The police finally caught the criminal who stole money from the store.
zh: 警方終於抓到偷了店裡錢的罪犯。

en: Grandma's fried chicken is crispy on the outside and soft inside.
zh: 奶奶做的炸雞外皮酥脆、裡面軟嫩。

en: Rice is the main crop in this part of Taiwan.
zh: 稻米是台灣這個地區的主要農作物。

en: The king wore a gold crown on his head.
zh: 國王頭上戴著一頂金色的王冠。

en: It is cruel to leave a dog alone in a hot car.
zh: 把狗獨自留在炎熱的車裡是很殘忍的。

en: Please put the clean bowls back in the cupboard.
zh: 請把乾淨的碗放回櫥櫃裡。

en: Milk, cheese, and butter are all dairy products.
zh: 牛奶、起司和奶油都是乳製品。

en: The new dam stores water for the city during the dry season.
zh: 這座新水壩在乾季時為城市儲水。

en: Nobody dared to swim in the cold river in winter.
zh: 冬天沒有人敢在冰冷的河裡游泳。

en: "Come here, darling," Mom said to the crying little girl.
zh: 「過來，親愛的。」媽媽對哭泣的小女孩說。

en: Tom made a dash for the bus when he saw it coming.
zh: 湯姆看到公車來了，就衝過去追。

en: The library has a database of all its books and magazines.
zh: 圖書館有一個收錄所有書籍和雜誌的資料庫。

en: Farmers often start working at dawn, before the sun gets hot.
zh: 農夫常在黎明時分、太陽還不熱之前就開始工作。

en: Dad bought his new car from a dealer near our home.
zh: 爸爸向我們家附近的一家經銷商買了新車。

en: Our town has changed a lot over the past decade.
zh: 我們的小鎮在過去十年間改變很多。

en: We stood on the deck of the ship and watched the sea.
zh: 我們站在船的甲板上看海。

en: The students decorated the classroom with balloons for the party.
zh: 學生們用氣球裝飾教室，準備開派對。

en: The number of students in this village has decreased every year.
zh: 這個村莊的學生人數每年都在減少。

en: Helping the old lady cross the street was a good deed.
zh: 幫助老太太過馬路是一件善行。

en: Reading many books can deepen your understanding of the world.
zh: 多讀書能加深你對世界的了解。

en: Look up the definition of this word in your dictionary.
zh: 在你的字典裡查這個字的定義。

en: In a democracy, people can choose their leaders by voting.
zh: 在民主制度下，人民可以透過投票選出領導人。

en: Our class made a democratic choice by letting everyone vote.
zh: 我們班讓每個人投票，做出了民主的決定。

en: You need to pay a small deposit when you borrow a bike here.
zh: 在這裡借腳踏車需要先付一小筆押金。

en: Lily dreams of becoming a designer who makes beautiful clothes.
zh: 莉莉夢想成為一位製作漂亮衣服的設計師。

en: Living near a good school is desirable for many families.
zh: 住在好學校附近是許多家庭所嚮往的。

en: Ken has a strong desire to travel around the world.
zh: 肯非常渴望能環遊世界。

en: After dinner, we had ice cream for dessert.
zh: 晚餐後，我們吃冰淇淋當甜點。

en: The strong storm destroyed many houses near the beach.
zh: 強烈的暴風雨摧毀了海邊的許多房子。

en: The machine can detect smoke and make a loud sound.
zh: 這台機器能偵測到煙霧並發出很大的聲響。

en: The test results will determine which class you will join.
zh: 測驗結果將決定你會進入哪一班。

en: In the story, the devil tries to trick a poor farmer.
zh: 在故事裡，魔鬼想要欺騙一個貧窮的農夫。

en: The light in the room was too dim for reading.
zh: 房間裡的光線太昏暗，不適合看書。

en: A dime is worth ten cents in the United States.
zh: 在美國，一角硬幣價值十分錢。

en: We dined at a nice restaurant for Grandpa's eightieth birthday.
zh: 我們在一家不錯的餐廳用餐，慶祝爺爺八十歲生日。

en: The museum has a huge model of a dinosaur.
zh: 博物館裡有一個巨大的恐龍模型。

en: Grandpa likes to dip his bread in hot milk.
zh: 爺爺喜歡把麵包沾熱牛奶吃。

en: After playing soccer, Tom's shoes were covered in dirt.
zh: 踢完足球後，湯姆的鞋子沾滿了泥土。

en: Students can get a discount at this bookstore with their ID cards.
zh: 學生持學生證在這家書店可以享有折扣。

en: It is dishonest to copy a classmate's answers on a test.
zh: 考試時抄同學的答案是不誠實的。

en: The old computer game came on a small disk.
zh: 那款老電腦遊戲是裝在一張小磁碟片裡。

en: Many children dislike vegetables, but my brother loves them.
zh: 很多小孩不喜歡蔬菜，但我弟弟很喜歡。

en: Heavy rain filled the ditch beside the road with water.
zh: 大雨使路邊的水溝積滿了水。

en: It is dangerous to dive into water that is not deep.
zh: 跳進不深的水裡是很危險的。

en: The hot weather made Grandma feel dizzy, so she sat down.
zh: 炎熱的天氣讓奶奶覺得頭暈，所以她坐了下來。

en: The boat will arrive at the dock in ten minutes.
zh: 船十分鐘後會抵達碼頭。

en: We watched a dolphin jump out of the sea near the boat.
zh: 我們看到一隻海豚在船附近躍出海面。

en: The farmer's donkey carried heavy bags up the hill every morning.
zh: 農夫的驢子每天早上把沉重的袋子運上山。

en: Take one dose of this medicine after each meal, the doctor said.
zh: 醫生說，每餐飯後服用一劑這種藥。

en: Mom looked doubtful when I said I had finished my homework.
zh: 我說我寫完功課了，媽媽看起來一臉懷疑。

en: Amy bought a sweet doughnut and a cup of milk for breakfast.
zh: 艾美早餐買了一個甜甜圈和一杯牛奶。

en: We took the bus downtown to see a movie on Saturday.
zh: 我們星期六搭公車到市中心看電影。

en: The bag was so heavy that Tom had to drag it along the floor.
zh: 袋子太重了，湯姆只好在地上拖著走。

en: A dragonfly flew over the pond and landed on a leaf.
zh: 一隻蜻蜓飛過池塘，停在一片葉子上。

en: After the heavy rain, the water slowly drained from the streets.
zh: 大雨過後，街上的積水慢慢排掉了。

en: There was a dramatic change in the weather, from sunny to stormy.
zh: 天氣有了劇烈的變化，從晴天轉為暴風雨。

en: Water kept dripping from the old roof all night long.
zh: 水整晚不停地從老舊的屋頂滴下來。

en: Never swim alone in the river, or you might drown.
zh: 千萬不要獨自在河裡游泳，否則可能會溺水。

en: Dad went to the drugstore to buy some medicine for my cold.
zh: 爸爸去藥房幫我買感冒藥。

en: People who are drunk should never drive a car.
zh: 喝醉的人絕對不該開車。

en: Don't be afraid to ask questions; no question is dumb.
zh: 別害怕發問，沒有任何問題是愚蠢的。

en: Please don't dump your trash on the beach.
zh: 請不要把垃圾倒在海灘上。

en: Grandma makes delicious dumplings for the whole family every winter.
zh: 奶奶每年冬天都會為全家人包美味的水餃。

en: The old books on the shelf were covered with dust.
zh: 書架上的舊書布滿了灰塵。

en: The students were eager to start their summer vacation.
zh: 學生們渴望開始放暑假。

en: We shouted in the cave and heard our echo come back.
zh: 我們在山洞裡大喊，聽到了自己的回音。

en: Please edit your report and fix the spelling mistakes before Friday.
zh: 請在星期五前編修你的報告，改正拼字錯誤。

en: The editor of the school newspaper chose my story for the front page.
zh: 校刊的編輯選了我的故事登在頭版。

en: Parents and teachers work together to educate children.
zh: 父母和老師共同合作教育孩子。

en: This TV program is both fun and educational for young kids.
zh: 這個電視節目對小孩來說既有趣又有教育意義。

en: Amy is very efficient; she finishes her homework in half an hour.
zh: 艾美很有效率，她半小時就寫完功課了。

en: Tom fell off his bike and hurt his left elbow.
zh: 湯姆從腳踏車上摔下來，傷到了左手肘。

en: The boy gave his seat on the bus to an elderly woman.
zh: 那個男孩在公車上把座位讓給一位年長的婦人。

en: Our class will elect a new class leader next week.
zh: 我們班下週要選出新的班長。

en: The school held an election to choose the student president.
zh: 學校舉辦選舉來選出學生會會長。

en: Please turn off the lights when you leave to save electricity.
zh: 離開時請關燈，以節約用電。

en: The electronic dictionary on my phone helps me learn new words.
zh: 我手機上的電子辭典幫助我學習新單字。

en: Hard work is an important element of success.
zh: 努力是成功的重要因素。

en: We took the elevator to the tenth floor of the building.
zh: 我們搭電梯到大樓的十樓。

en: In an emergency, call 119 for help right away.
zh: 遇到緊急情況時，立刻撥打119求救。

en: Mom became very emotional when I gave her a birthday card.
zh: 我送媽媽生日卡片時，她的情緒變得很激動。

en: The emperor ruled the country for more than forty years.
zh: 那位皇帝統治這個國家四十多年。

en: The new bridge enables people to cross the river quickly.
zh: 這座新橋讓人們能快速過河。

en: The children were so energetic that they played soccer all afternoon.
zh: 孩子們精力充沛，踢了一整個下午的足球。

en: Students who engage in sports often stay healthy and happy.
zh: 參與運動的學生通常能保持健康快樂。

en: We had an enjoyable day at the beach with our cousins.
zh: 我們和表兄弟姊妹在海邊度過了愉快的一天。

en: Entry to the museum is free for students on Sundays.
zh: 星期日學生可免費入場參觀博物館。

en: Many classmates envy Tom because he can speak three languages.
zh: 許多同學很羨慕湯姆，因為他會說三種語言。

en: Please erase the board before the next class begins.
zh: 請在下一堂課開始前把黑板擦乾淨。

en: The school gave Amy a prize for her excellence in math.
zh: 學校頒獎給艾美，表揚她在數學上的卓越表現。

en: Tom and I exchanged phone numbers after the first day of school.
zh: 開學第一天後，湯姆和我交換了電話號碼。

en: Our class visited an art exhibition at the city museum.
zh: 我們班去市立博物館參觀了一場藝術展覽。

en: Her parents have high expectations for her school grades.
zh: 她的父母對她的學業成績期望很高。

en: In science class, we did an experiment with water and salt.
zh: 在自然課上，我們用水和鹽做了一個實驗。

en: The balloon exploded with a loud noise when Tom sat on it.
zh: 湯姆坐到氣球上，氣球砰的一聲爆炸了。

en: On the weekend, we explored the mountains near our town.
zh: 週末時，我們去探索了小鎮附近的山區。

en: Taiwan exports a lot of fruit to other countries every year.
zh: 台灣每年出口大量水果到其他國家。

en: Her expressive eyes showed how happy she was to see us.
zh: 她那富有表情的雙眼流露出見到我們有多開心。

en: Some people cannot stand the extreme heat of summer in Taipei.
zh: 有些人受不了台北夏天的極端高溫。

en: The colors of my old T-shirt have faded in the sun.
zh: 我那件舊T恤的顏色被太陽曬到褪色了。

en: We heard a faint sound of music from the house next door.
zh: 我們聽到隔壁傳來微弱的音樂聲。

en: The test was fairly easy, so most students finished early.
zh: 這次考試相當簡單，所以大部分學生都提早寫完。

en: My little sister loves stories about a fairy with magic wings.
zh: 我妹妹很喜歡長著魔法翅膀的仙子的故事。

en: The coach has faith in his players, even after a bad game.
zh: 即使比賽表現不佳，教練仍對他的球員深具信心。

en: Don't believe that news; the photo in it is fake.
zh: 別相信那則新聞，裡面的照片是假的。

en: Her voice sounds familiar, but I can't remember her name.
zh: 她的聲音聽起來很熟悉，但我想不起她的名字。

en: We ate dinner at a fancy restaurant for Grandpa's birthday.
zh: 我們在一家高級餐廳吃晚餐，慶祝爺爺的生日。

en: The bus fare from school to my home is fifteen dollars.
zh: 從學校到我家的公車車資是十五元。

en: My house is farther from school than Amy's house.
zh: 我家離學校比艾美家更遠。

en: Short hair is very fashionable among girls this year.
zh: 今年短髮在女生之間非常時髦。

en: Please turn off the faucet after you wash your hands.
zh: 洗完手後請關掉水龍頭。

en: The little boy was fearful of the big dog next door.
zh: 那個小男孩很害怕隔壁的大狗。

en: A soft white feather fell from the bird as it flew away.
zh: 那隻鳥飛走時，掉下一根柔軟的白色羽毛。

en: The dog jumped over the fence and ran into the street.
zh: 那隻狗跳過籬笆，跑到街上。

en: Grandma is a true fighter; she never gives up when she is sick.
zh: 奶奶是真正的鬥士，生病時從不放棄。

en: Many families watched the colorful fireworks over the river last night.
zh: 昨晚許多家庭在河邊觀賞繽紛的煙火。

en: The baby held my finger tightly in her small fist.
zh: 小寶寶用她的小拳頭緊緊握住我的手指。

en: Be careful; the flame of the candle is very hot.
zh: 小心，蠟燭的火焰很燙。

en: A flash of light filled the sky during the storm.
zh: 暴風雨中，一道閃光照亮了天空。

en: When the power went out, we used a flashlight to find candles.
zh: 停電時，我們用手電筒找蠟燭。

en: Which ice cream flavor do you like best, chocolate or strawberry?
zh: 你最喜歡哪種口味的冰淇淋，巧克力還是草莓？

en: The flesh of this mango is sweet and soft.
zh: 這顆芒果的果肉又甜又軟。

en: Leaves were floating on the water in the pond.
zh: 樹葉漂浮在池塘的水面上。

en: A flock of birds flew south before winter came.
zh: 冬天來臨前，一群鳥往南飛去。

en: Heavy rain caused a flood in the lower part of the town.
zh: 大雨在鎮上地勢較低的地區造成了洪水。

en: To make bread, you need flour, water, and a little salt.
zh: 要做麵包，你需要麵粉、水和一點鹽。

en: Amy plays the flute in the school band.
zh: 艾美在學校樂隊吹長笛。

en: It was so foggy this morning that we couldn't see the mountains.
zh: 今天早上霧很濃，我們看不到山。

en: Please fold your clothes and put them in the closet.
zh: 請把你的衣服摺好，放進衣櫃裡。

en: The singer has more than a million followers online.
zh: 那位歌手在網路上有超過一百萬名追隨者。

en: My grandfather is very fond of growing vegetables in his garden.
zh: 我爺爺很喜歡在他的菜園裡種菜。

en: We promised that we would be best friends forever.
zh: 我們約定要永遠當最好的朋友。

en: The man made a fortune from his small noodle shop.
zh: 那個男人靠著他的小麵店累積了一大筆財富。

en: Children played in the water from the fountain in the park.
zh: 孩子們在公園的噴泉旁玩水。

en: To be frank, I didn't enjoy the movie at all.
zh: 坦白說，我一點也不喜歡那部電影。

en: Water will freeze if the temperature drops below zero.
zh: 如果溫度降到零度以下，水就會結冰。

en: Please put the fish in the freezer when we get home.
zh: 我們回到家後，請把魚放進冷凍庫。

en: Tom is a frequent visitor to the library near his home.
zh: 湯姆常去他家附近的圖書館。

en: The loud thunder gave my little brother a fright.
zh: 響亮的雷聲把我弟弟嚇了一跳。

en: Please speak softly so you don't frighten the baby.
zh: 請小聲說話，以免嚇到寶寶。

en: Cars need fuel to run, just as people need food.
zh: 汽車需要燃料才能行駛，就像人需要食物一樣。

en: Our class sold cookies to raise funds for a school trip.
zh: 我們班賣餅乾，為校外教學募集資金。

en: The cat's soft white fur keeps it warm in winter.
zh: 那隻貓柔軟的白色毛皮讓牠在冬天保持溫暖。

en: Dad bought a gallon of milk at the supermarket.
zh: 爸爸在超市買了一加侖的牛奶。

en: Grandpa told me never to gamble with my money.
zh: 爺爺告訴我絕對不要拿錢去賭博。

en: A gang of kids played basketball in the park after school.
zh: 放學後，一夥孩子在公園裡打籃球。

en: There is a small gap between the door and the floor.
zh: 門和地板之間有一個小縫隙。

en: Dad parks his car in the garage every night.
zh: 爸爸每天晚上都把車停在車庫裡。

en: We stopped to buy gasoline before driving up the mountain.
zh: 開車上山前，我們先停下來加汽油。

en: In geography class, we learned about the rivers of Taiwan.
zh: 在地理課上，我們學習了台灣的河流。

en: Tom made a friendly gesture by waving his hand at us.
zh: 湯姆向我們揮手，做出友善的手勢。

en: Amy took a quick glance at her watch and ran to class.
zh: 艾美很快地瞥了一眼手錶，就跑去上課了。

en: Global warming is a problem for every country in the world.
zh: 全球暖化是世界上每個國家都面臨的問題。

en: The team won the game and returned home in glory.
zh: 球隊贏得比賽，光榮地回到家鄉。

en: The lights of the city glowed softly in the dark night.
zh: 城市的燈火在黑夜裡散發柔和的光芒。

en: My uncle plays golf with his friends every Sunday morning.
zh: 我叔叔每個星期天早上都和朋友打高爾夫球。

en: It is not nice to spread gossip about your classmates.
zh: 散播同學的八卦是不好的行為。

en: The governor of the state gave a speech to the students.
zh: 那位州長對學生們發表了演講。

en: Tom grabbed his bag and ran to catch the bus.
zh: 湯姆抓起書包，跑去趕公車。

en: My sister will graduate from high school next June.
zh: 我姊姊明年六月就要高中畢業了。

en: Amy grasped the rope tightly and climbed up the wall.
zh: 艾美緊緊抓住繩子，爬上了牆。

en: A green grasshopper jumped from the grass onto my shoe.
zh: 一隻綠色的蚱蜢從草地跳到我的鞋子上。

en: We had a picnic on a grassy hill near the lake.
zh: 我們在湖邊一座長滿草的小山丘上野餐。

en: The greedy boy ate all the cookies and left none for his sister.
zh: 那個貪心的男孩把餅乾全吃光了，一片也沒留給妹妹。

en: Grandpa grows tomatoes in a greenhouse, even in winter.
zh: 爺爺在溫室裡種番茄，即使冬天也一樣。

en: Tom had a big grin on his face after winning the race.
zh: 湯姆贏得賽跑後，咧著嘴笑得很開心。

en: Mom goes to the grocery store every Saturday morning.
zh: 媽媽每個星期六早上都會去雜貨店。

en: With her teacher's guidance, Amy improved her English a lot.
zh: 在老師的指導下，艾美的英文進步很多。

en: Students may not chew gum in the classroom.
zh: 學生不可以在教室裡嚼口香糖。

en: The hairdresser cut my hair short for the summer.
zh: 美髮師為了夏天把我的頭髮剪短了。

en: Please don't run in the hallway between classes.
zh: 下課時請不要在走廊上奔跑。

en: Dad used a hammer to hang a picture on the wall.
zh: 爸爸用鐵鎚把一幅畫掛到牆上。

en: Only a handful of students stayed after class to help clean.
zh: 只有少數幾個學生下課後留下來幫忙打掃。

en: Grandpa always carries a handkerchief in his pocket.
zh: 爺爺口袋裡總是帶著一條手帕。

en: A small umbrella is handy to keep in your school bag.
zh: 書包裡放一把小雨傘很方便。

en: Please hang your coat on a hanger in the closet.
zh: 請把你的外套掛在衣櫃的衣架上。

en: Many fishing boats return to the harbor in the evening.
zh: 許多漁船傍晚會回到港口。

en: Too much sugar can do harm to your teeth.
zh: 吃太多糖會傷害你的牙齒。

en: Staying up late every night is harmful to your health.
zh: 每晚熬夜對你的健康有害。

en: Farmers are busy with the rice harvest in the fall.
zh: 農夫們在秋天忙著收割稻米。

en: Don't make a hasty decision; think about it carefully first.
zh: 別草率做決定，先仔細想清楚。

en: Three baby birds hatched from their eggs this morning.
zh: 今天早上，三隻小鳥從蛋裡孵出來了。

en: It was hateful of them to laugh at the new student.
zh: 他們嘲笑新同學，真是可恨。

en: The farmer gave the horses some hay to eat.
zh: 農夫給那些馬一些乾草吃。

en: The headline of today's newspaper is about the typhoon.
zh: 今天報紙的頭條是關於颱風的消息。

en: The company's headquarters is in a tall building in Taipei.
zh: 那家公司的總部位於台北一棟高樓裡。

en: The cut on my finger healed in about a week.
zh: 我手指上的傷口大約一週就癒合了。

en: There was a heap of dirty clothes on Tom's bed.
zh: 湯姆的床上有一堆髒衣服。

en: It was so cold that we kept the heater on all night.
zh: 天氣太冷了，我們整晚都開著暖氣機。

en: My new shoes hurt the back of my heel.
zh: 我的新鞋磨得我的腳跟好痛。

en: Waiting in the hot sun for two hours felt like hell.
zh: 在大太陽下等了兩個小時，感覺像在地獄一樣。

en: Always wear a helmet when you ride a motorcycle.
zh: 騎機車時一定要戴安全帽。

en: If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask me.
zh: 如果你有任何問題，別猶豫，儘管問我。

en: I can't guess the answer; can you give me a hint?
zh: 我猜不出答案，你可以給我一點提示嗎？

en: The restaurant plans to hire two more waiters for the summer.
zh: 那家餐廳打算在夏天多僱用兩名服務生。

en: The historian told us many stories about old Taipei.
zh: 那位歷史學家告訴我們許多老台北的故事。

en: We visited a historic temple that is three hundred years old.
zh: 我們參觀了一座具有三百年歷史的古廟。

en: Amy keeps her pens in a small holder on her desk.
zh: 艾美把筆放在書桌上的一個小筆筒裡。

en: The old tree is hollow inside, and a bird lives there.
zh: 那棵老樹裡面是空心的，有一隻鳥住在裡面。

en: For many people, this mountain is a holy place.
zh: 對許多人來說，這座山是神聖的地方。

en: During her first week at camp, Amy felt very homesick.
zh: 參加營隊的第一週，艾美非常想家。

en: Every summer, Dad takes us back to his hometown in the south.
zh: 每年夏天，爸爸都會帶我們回他南部的家鄉。

en: The teacher praised Tom for his honesty when he returned the lost wallet.
zh: 湯姆歸還了遺失的錢包，老師稱讚他的誠實。

en: It is a great honor to play for our school team.
zh: 能為校隊出賽是莫大的榮譽。

en: The doctor is hopeful that Grandma will get better soon.
zh: 醫生抱持希望，認為奶奶很快就會好轉。

en: A goat has two short horns on its head.
zh: 山羊頭上長著兩隻短短的角。

en: The weather was horrible, so we stayed home all weekend.
zh: 天氣糟透了，所以我們整個週末都待在家。

en: My brother loves horror movies, but they scare me.
zh: 我哥哥很愛看恐怖片，但我看了會害怕。

en: The train to Taichung leaves hourly from this station.
zh: 往台中的火車每小時從這個車站發車一班。

en: The housekeeper cleans the house and cooks dinner for the family.
zh: 那位管家負責打掃房子，並為這家人煮晚餐。

en: Grandma gave me a big hug when I arrived.
zh: 我到的時候，奶奶給了我一個大大的擁抱。

en: Amy likes to hum her favorite songs while she cooks.
zh: 艾美喜歡一邊煮飯一邊哼她最愛的歌。

en: Summer in Taiwan is very hot and humid.
zh: 台灣的夏天非常炎熱潮濕。

en: Our math teacher has a great sense of humor.
zh: 我們的數學老師很有幽默感。

en: Everyone laughed at Tom's humorous story about his dog.
zh: 大家聽了湯姆那個關於他家狗狗的幽默故事都笑了。

en: After playing ball all day, the boys were weak from hunger.
zh: 打了一整天的球後，男孩們餓得全身無力。

en: We stayed in a small wooden hut on the mountain.
zh: 我們住在山上一間小木屋裡。

en: Drive slowly; the roads are icy after the snow.
zh: 開慢一點，下雪後路面都結冰了。

en: Children have a wonderful imagination and love to tell stories.
zh: 孩子們擁有很棒的想像力，也喜歡說故事。

en: Thanks for your immediate reply to my message.
zh: 謝謝你立即回覆我的訊息。

en: Taiwan imports most of its oil from other countries.
zh: 台灣大部分的石油都是從其他國家進口的。

en: Amy's beautiful singing impressed everyone at the party.
zh: 艾美優美的歌聲讓派對上的每個人都印象深刻。

en: On rainy days, we play indoor games in the classroom.
zh: 下雨天時，我們在教室裡玩室內遊戲。

en: It is raining hard, so let's stay indoors today.
zh: 雨下得很大，我們今天就待在室內吧。

en: There are many factories in this industrial area.
zh: 這個工業區裡有很多工廠。

en: This cheap phone is inferior to the one I had before.
zh: 這支便宜的手機比我以前那支還差。

en: Please inform your teacher if you will be absent tomorrow.
zh: 如果你明天會缺席，請通知你的老師。

en: You can find more information about the trip on the school website.
zh: 你可以在學校網站上找到更多關於這次旅行的資訊。

en: Tom missed the basketball game because of a knee injury.
zh: 湯姆因為膝蓋受傷而錯過了籃球比賽。

en: We spent the night at a small inn by the sea.
zh: 我們在海邊的一家小旅館過夜。

en: The inner part of the fruit is soft and sweet.
zh: 這種水果的內部又軟又甜。

en: Tom was innocent; he did not break the window.
zh: 湯姆是無辜的，窗戶不是他打破的。

en: The teacher inspected our desks to make sure they were clean.
zh: 老師檢查了我們的書桌，確認桌面都很乾淨。

en: A health inspector checked the kitchen of the restaurant.
zh: 一名衛生檢查員檢查了那家餐廳的廚房。

en: Dolphins are intelligent animals that can learn many tricks.
zh: 海豚是聰明的動物，可以學會許多把戲。

en: Please don't interrupt me while I am talking on the phone.
zh: 我在講電話時，請不要打斷我。

en: Who invented the telephone more than a hundred years ago?
zh: 一百多年前是誰發明了電話？

en: The young inventor made a robot that can clean the floor.
zh: 那位年輕的發明家做了一台會掃地的機器人。

en: The police are investigating why the fire started.
zh: 警方正在調查火災發生的原因。

en: Amy sent me an invitation to her birthday party.
zh: 艾美寄給我一張她生日派對的邀請函。

en: It is against the law to buy or sell ivory.
zh: 買賣象牙是違法的。

en: The man was sent to jail for stealing a car.
zh: 那個男人因為偷車而被關進監獄。

en: Mom keeps cookies in a glass jar on the kitchen shelf.
zh: 媽媽把餅乾放在廚房架子上的一個玻璃罐裡。

en: Tom's jaw hurt after he ate a lot of hard candy.
zh: 湯姆吃了很多硬糖之後，下巴很痛。

en: My father likes to listen to jazz while he drives.
zh: 我爸爸開車時喜歡聽爵士樂。

en: Amy felt jealous when her best friend sat with another girl.
zh: 艾美的好朋友和另一個女生坐在一起時，她感到很忌妒。

en: We rode in a jeep along the rocky mountain road.
zh: 我們搭著吉普車，沿著崎嶇的山路前進。

en: My little sister likes to eat jelly after dinner.
zh: 我妹妹喜歡在晚餐後吃果凍。

en: A jet flew high above the clouds on its way to Japan.
zh: 一架噴射機在雲層上方高高飛過，正飛往日本。

en: The old box was full of gold coins and shining jewels.
zh: 那個舊盒子裡裝滿了金幣和閃閃發亮的寶石。

en: Mom keeps her jewelry in a small box in her bedroom.
zh: 媽媽把她的珠寶放在臥室的一個小盒子裡。

en: The train journey to the east coast took about three hours.
zh: 搭火車到東海岸的旅程大約花了三個小時。

en: Everyone sang joyful songs at the New Year party.
zh: 大家在新年派對上唱著歡樂的歌曲。

en: These oranges from Grandpa's farm are sweet and juicy.
zh: 這些來自爺爺農場的柳橙又甜又多汁。

en: Many kinds of monkeys and birds live in the jungle.
zh: 許多種類的猴子和鳥類住在叢林裡。

en: My brother is in junior high school, and I'm in senior high.
zh: 我弟弟讀國中，我讀高中。

en: The garage is full of old junk that nobody uses.
zh: 車庫裡堆滿了沒人要用的廢物。

en: A baby kangaroo lives in its mother's pouch for months.
zh: 小袋鼠會在媽媽的育兒袋裡住好幾個月。

en: Some keys on my computer keyboard don't work anymore.
zh: 我電腦鍵盤上有些按鍵已經壞了。

en: Drinking enough water is good for your kidneys.
zh: 喝足夠的水對腎臟有益。

en: Tom runs five kilometers around the park every morning.
zh: 湯姆每天早上繞著公園跑五公里。

en: My little sister goes to kindergarten near our home.
zh: 我妹妹在我們家附近讀幼稚園。

en: The king ruled a small kingdom by the sea.
zh: 那位國王統治著海邊的一個小王國。

en: Every classroom has a first aid kit in case someone gets hurt.
zh: 每間教室都有一個急救箱，以防有人受傷。

en: In the story, a brave knight saved the village from a dragon.
zh: 故事裡，一位勇敢的騎士從惡龍手中拯救了村莊。

en: Grandma knitted a warm sweater for me last winter.
zh: 奶奶去年冬天為我織了一件溫暖的毛衣。

en: Tom tied the two ropes together with a strong knot.
zh: 湯姆用一個牢固的結把兩條繩子綁在一起。

en: Koalas sleep for most of the day in trees.
zh: 無尾熊一天大部分時間都在樹上睡覺。

en: Read the label on the bottle before you take the medicine.
zh: 服藥前，請先看清楚瓶子上的標籤。

en: My sister's white dress has beautiful lace at the bottom.
zh: 我姊姊的白色洋裝下襬有漂亮的蕾絲。

en: Dad climbed a ladder to clean the top of the windows.
zh: 爸爸爬上梯子去清理窗戶的上方。

en: Have you watched any good movies or TV shows lately?
zh: 你最近有看什麼好看的電影或電視節目嗎？

en: The classroom was filled with laughter after the teacher's joke.
zh: 老師說完笑話後，教室裡充滿了笑聲。

en: On Sundays, I help my mom do the laundry.
zh: 每到星期天，我都會幫媽媽洗衣服。

en: Dad cuts the grass on our front lawn every two weeks.
zh: 爸爸每兩週修剪一次我們前院草坪上的草。

en: Water is leaking from the pipe under the kitchen sink.
zh: 水從廚房水槽下方的水管漏出來。

en: The cat made a high leap onto the table.
zh: 那隻貓高高一跳，跳上了桌子。

en: Online learning became popular when students had to study at home.
zh: 學生必須在家讀書時，線上學習變得很普遍。

en: Dad bought a brown leather bag for work.
zh: 爸爸買了一個上班用的棕色皮革包。

en: In her leisure time, Amy enjoys reading and drawing.
zh: 艾美在閒暇時間喜歡閱讀和畫畫。

en: On hot days, a cold glass of lemonade tastes wonderful.
zh: 炎熱的日子裡，喝一杯冰涼的檸檬水感覺棒極了。

en: The leopard has yellow fur with black spots.
zh: 豹有著帶黑色斑點的黃色毛皮。

en: Mom put some fresh lettuce and tomatoes in the sandwich.
zh: 媽媽在三明治裡放了一些新鮮的萵苣和番茄。

en: Every person should have the liberty to say what they think.
zh: 每個人都應該享有說出自己想法的自由。

en: The little dog licked my face when I came home.
zh: 我回到家時，小狗舔了舔我的臉。

en: Grandpa says a true friend can last a lifetime.
zh: 爺爺說，真正的友誼可以維持一輩子。

en: The lighthouse helps ships find their way at night.
zh: 燈塔在夜裡幫助船隻找到方向。

en: We saw lightning in the sky and then heard thunder.
zh: 我們看到天空中的閃電，接著聽到雷聲。

en: Mom bought some white lilies from the flower shop.
zh: 媽媽從花店買了一些白色的百合。

en: After the long run, all my limbs felt tired and heavy.
zh: 長跑完後，我的四肢都覺得又累又沉重。

en: Please don't litter; put your trash in the trash can.
zh: 請不要亂丟垃圾，把垃圾丟進垃圾桶裡。

en: Amy is a lively girl who loves to sing and dance.
zh: 艾美是個活潑的女孩，喜歡唱歌跳舞。

en: Mom bought a loaf of bread at the bakery.
zh: 媽媽在麵包店買了一條麵包。

en: Let's meet in the hotel lobby at nine o'clock.
zh: 我們九點在飯店大廳碰面吧。

en: Can you locate Taiwan on this world map?
zh: 你能在這張世界地圖上找出台灣的位置嗎？

en: The new library is in a great location near the train station.
zh: 新的圖書館位置很好，就在火車站附近。

en: Don't forget to lock the door when you leave the house.
zh: 離開家時別忘了鎖門。

en: Our science teacher asked us to keep a log of the weather every day.
zh: 我們的自然老師要我們每天記錄天氣日誌。

en: The little boy smiled happily when the nurse gave him a lollipop.
zh: 護士給小男孩一支棒棒糖時，他開心地笑了。

en: These pants are too loose, so I need a smaller size.
zh: 這條褲子太鬆了，所以我需要小一號的。

en: In the old story, the lord lived in a big castle on the hill.
zh: 在那個古老的故事裡，那位君主住在山丘上的一座大城堡裡。

en: Don't call yourself a loser just because you failed one test.
zh: 別只因為一次考試沒考好，就說自己是失敗者。

en: Grandpa is a music lover who listens to old songs every morning.
zh: 爺爺是個音樂愛好者，每天早上都聽老歌。

en: We put all our luggage in the car before driving to the airport.
zh: 開車去機場之前，我們把所有行李放進車裡。

en: Smoking can hurt your lungs and make it hard to breathe.
zh: 抽菸會傷害你的肺，讓你呼吸困難。

en: The night market looked magical with all its bright lights.
zh: 夜市在滿滿的明亮燈光下，看起來好神奇。

en: The magician pulled a white rabbit out of his hat.
zh: 魔術師從他的帽子裡拉出一隻白兔。

en: Mom used a magnet to hold the photo on the refrigerator door.
zh: 媽媽用磁鐵把照片固定在冰箱門上。

en: The rich family had a maid who cleaned the house every day.
zh: 那戶有錢人家有一位女僕每天打掃房子。

en: The majority of students in our class walk to school.
zh: 我們班大多數的學生走路上學。

en: Amy and her friends went shopping at the new mall on Sunday.
zh: 艾咪和她的朋友星期天去新開的購物中心逛街。

en: Clean water is one of the most important needs of mankind.
zh: 乾淨的水是人類最重要的需求之一。

en: The floor of the old hotel was made of white marble.
zh: 那家老飯店的地板是用白色大理石做的。

en: The students marched around the playground on Sports Day.
zh: 運動會那天，學生們繞著操場行進。

en: Please write your name on the box with a black marker.
zh: 請用黑色麥克筆在盒子上寫下你的名字。

en: We had a marvelous time at the beach last summer.
zh: 去年夏天，我們在海邊度過了一段非常美好的時光。

en: Tom is good at solving difficult mathematical problems in class.
zh: 湯姆很擅長在課堂上解困難的數學問題。

en: The mayor visited our school and talked about the new library.
zh: 市長來我們學校參觀，並談到新的圖書館。

en: Cows were eating grass in the green meadow near the farm.
zh: 牛群在農場附近的綠色草地上吃草。

en: Helping old people at the park was a meaningful experience for us.
zh: 在公園幫助老人家，對我們來說是很有意義的經驗。

en: Dad cooked dinner; meanwhile, the kids set the table.
zh: 爸爸煮晚餐；同時，孩子們把餐桌擺好。

en: She won a gold medal in the swimming race.
zh: 她在游泳比賽中贏得一面金牌。

en: The internet is a popular medium for learning new things.
zh: 網路是學習新事物的熱門媒介。

en: On hot days, a cold slice of melon tastes wonderful.
zh: 天氣熱的時候，一片冰涼的甜瓜吃起來美味極了。

en: The ice cream began to melt in the hot sun.
zh: 冰淇淋在炎熱的太陽下開始融化。

en: Grandma helped me mend the hole in my old shirt.
zh: 奶奶幫我補好舊襯衫上的破洞。

en: Getting enough sleep is good for both your body and mental health.
zh: 充足的睡眠對你的身體和心理健康都有好處。

en: Everyone sang merry songs at the Christmas party.
zh: 大家在聖誕派對上唱著歡樂的歌。

en: His bedroom was a mess, with clothes all over the floor.
zh: 他的房間一團亂，衣服丟得滿地都是。

en: The singer held the microphone close and began to sing.
zh: 歌手把麥克風拿近，開始唱歌。

en: Please heat the milk in the microwave for one minute.
zh: 請把牛奶放進微波爐加熱一分鐘。

en: The mighty king ruled the land for fifty years.
zh: 那位強大的國王統治這片土地長達五十年。

en: In math class, we learned that ten minus four is six.
zh: 在數學課上，我們學到十減四等於六。

en: It was a miracle that our weak team won the final game.
zh: 我們這支弱隊竟然贏得最後一場比賽，真是個奇蹟。

en: The bad cold made his whole week a misery.
zh: 那場重感冒讓他整個星期都很痛苦。

en: The news reported that the country tested a new missile.
zh: 新聞報導那個國家試射了一枚新飛彈。

en: One page of my notebook is missing, and I can't find it.
zh: 我的筆記本少了一頁，怎麼找都找不到。

en: Our mission today is to clean every classroom before the party.
zh: 我們今天的任務是在派對前把每間教室打掃乾淨。

en: A thin mist covered the mountains early in the morning.
zh: 清晨時，一層薄霧籠罩著群山。

en: Fans mobbed the singer as soon as she left the hotel.
zh: 那位歌手一走出飯店，就被粉絲團團圍住。

en: A mobile library brings books to children in small villages.
zh: 行動圖書館把書帶給小村莊的孩子們。

en: The chocolate cake was soft and moist inside.
zh: 這個巧克力蛋糕裡面又軟又濕潤。

en: The air in Taipei has a lot of moisture in summer.
zh: 台北夏天的空氣中有很多濕氣。

en: The monk lives quietly in a temple on the mountain.
zh: 那位僧侶安靜地住在山上的一座寺廟裡。

en: My little brother is afraid of the monster in the cartoon.
zh: 我弟弟很怕卡通裡的那隻怪物。

en: We have a monthly class meeting on the first Friday.
zh: 我們每個月的第一個星期五都會開一次班會。

en: The moral of the story is that we should always tell the truth.
zh: 這個故事的寓意是我們應該永遠說實話。

en: A mosquito bit me on the arm while I was sleeping.
zh: 我睡覺時，一隻蚊子叮了我的手臂。

en: Our school lunch is mostly rice, vegetables, and a little meat.
zh: 我們學校的午餐大多是米飯、蔬菜，還有一點肉。

en: We stayed at a small motel by the highway for one night.
zh: 我們在公路旁一家小汽車旅館住了一晚。

en: A moth flew around the light in the kitchen all night.
zh: 一隻蛾整晚繞著廚房的燈飛。

en: The toy boat has a small motor, so it can move by itself.
zh: 這艘玩具船有個小馬達，所以可以自己移動。

en: If you multiply three by four, you get twelve.
zh: 如果你把三乘以四，就會得到十二。

en: Amy doesn't like movies about murder because they scare her.
zh: 艾咪不喜歡關於謀殺的電影，因為那些電影會讓她害怕。

en: Swimming every day helps you build strong arm and leg muscles.
zh: 每天游泳有助於鍛鍊強壯的手臂和腿部肌肉。

en: Mom added fresh mushrooms to the soup for dinner.
zh: 媽媽在晚餐的湯裡加了新鮮的蘑菇。

en: How the cat got onto the roof is still a mystery.
zh: 那隻貓是怎麼爬上屋頂的，至今仍是個謎。

en: The baby ran around the house naked after his bath.
zh: 寶寶洗完澡後，光著身子在家裡跑來跑去。

en: Grandpa likes to take a short nap after lunch.
zh: 爺爺喜歡在午餐後小睡一下。

en: Please use a napkin to clean your mouth after eating.
zh: 吃完東西後，請用餐巾擦嘴。

en: Our new English teacher is a native speaker from Canada.
zh: 我們新的英文老師是來自加拿大、以英語為母語的人。

en: His uncle joined the navy and works on a big ship.
zh: 他的叔叔加入了海軍，在一艘大船上工作。

en: Her desk is always neat, with every book in its place.
zh: 她的書桌總是很整潔，每本書都放在該放的地方。

en: Water is a necessity for all living things.
zh: 水是所有生物的必需品。

en: Dad wears a blue necktie to work every Monday.
zh: 爸爸每週一都打藍色領帶去上班。

en: There are many good restaurants in our neighborhood.
zh: 我們家附近有很多不錯的餐廳。

en: Two birds built a nest in the tree outside my window.
zh: 兩隻鳥在我窗外的樹上築了一個巢。

en: His friends gave him the nickname Rabbit because he runs so fast.
zh: 因為他跑得很快，朋友們幫他取了「兔子」這個綽號。

en: It is normal to feel nervous before a big test.
zh: 大考前感到緊張是很正常的。

en: The novelist spent three years writing her first book.
zh: 那位小說家花了三年寫她的第一本書。

en: The nun took care of sick children at the church hospital.
zh: 那位修女在教會醫院照顧生病的孩子。

en: We had a picnic under a tall oak tree in the park.
zh: 我們在公園裡一棵高大的橡樹下野餐。

en: The class observed how the plants grew over two weeks.
zh: 全班觀察了那些植物在兩週內的生長情形。

en: Grandma only cooks this dish on special occasions like New Year.
zh: 奶奶只有在過年這類特別的場合，才會煮這道菜。

en: It was odd that the noisy classroom was suddenly so quiet.
zh: 吵鬧的教室突然變得那麼安靜，真奇怪。

en: You can omit the sugar if you want a healthier drink.
zh: 如果你想要更健康的飲料，可以省略不加糖。

en: The school's ongoing project is to plant more trees on campus.
zh: 學校正在進行的計畫是在校園裡種更多樹。

en: Cutting onions always makes Dad's eyes water in the kitchen.
zh: 在廚房切洋蔥，總是讓爸爸眼淚直流。

en: The cat jumped onto the table and ate my fish.
zh: 貓跳到桌上，吃掉了我的魚。

en: After the operation, Grandpa had to stay in the hospital for a week.
zh: 手術後，爺爺必須住院一個星期。

en: The trip to Japan was a great opportunity to practice speaking Japanese.
zh: 這趟日本之旅是練習說日語的好機會。

en: The bank is on the opposite side of the street.
zh: 銀行在街道的對面。

en: Even after losing the game, the coach stayed optimistic about next season.
zh: 即使輸了比賽，教練對下一季仍然保持樂觀。

en: We have an oral English test next Tuesday.
zh: 我們下星期二有一場英文口說測驗。

en: Mom buys organic vegetables because they are grown without chemicals.
zh: 媽媽買有機蔬菜，因為它們是不用化學物質種植的。

en: Amy helped organize the class party at the end of the term.
zh: 艾咪在學期末幫忙籌辦班級派對。

en: The movie is good, but the original book is even better.
zh: 這部電影很好看，但原著小說更精彩。

en: Basketball is the most popular outdoor sport at our school.
zh: 籃球是我們學校最受歡迎的戶外運動。

en: When the weather is nice, we like to eat outdoors.
zh: 天氣好的時候，我們喜歡在戶外吃飯。

en: The outer part of the bread is hard, but the inside is soft.
zh: 這個麵包外層很硬，但裡面很軟。

en: Before writing the report, make an outline of your main ideas.
zh: 寫報告之前，先把你的主要想法列成大綱。

en: Dad baked a chicken in the oven for Sunday dinner.
zh: 爸爸用烤箱烤了一隻雞當星期天的晚餐。

en: Her older brother is studying overseas in England this year.
zh: 她哥哥今年在英國留學。

en: Tom still owes his sister one hundred dollars for the movie ticket.
zh: 湯姆還欠他姊姊一百元的電影票錢。

en: The owl sleeps during the day and hunts at night.
zh: 貓頭鷹白天睡覺，晚上出來獵食。

en: The ownership of the bookstore passed from father to son.
zh: 這家書店的所有權由父親傳給了兒子。

en: In the past, farmers used an ox to help work in the fields.
zh: 過去，農夫用公牛幫忙在田裡工作。

en: Keep a pad and pen by the phone to write down messages.
zh: 在電話旁放一本便條本和一支筆，好記下留言。

en: The painter spent hours drawing the mountains by the lake.
zh: 那位畫家花了好幾個小時畫湖邊的山。

en: Tom and his old pal went fishing together last weekend.
zh: 湯姆和他的老朋友上週末一起去釣魚。

en: The king and queen lived in a beautiful palace.
zh: 國王和王后住在一座美麗的宮殿裡。

en: She held the small bird gently in the palm of her hand.
zh: 她把那隻小鳥輕輕捧在手掌心裡。

en: We ate pancakes with honey for breakfast this morning.
zh: 我們今天早餐吃了淋上蜂蜜的鬆餅。

en: Don't panic if you forget a word during your speech.
zh: 如果你演講時忘了某個字，別慌張。

en: Thousands of people watched the parade on New Year's Day.
zh: 元旦那天，數千人觀看了遊行。

en: With its blue sea and white sand, the island is a paradise.
zh: 那座島有藍色的海和白色的沙灘，簡直是天堂。

en: The mailman brought a parcel from Grandma this morning.
zh: 郵差今天早上送來一個奶奶寄來的包裹。

en: Our parrot can say hello to everyone who comes in.
zh: 我們家的鸚鵡會跟每個進門的人說哈囉。

en: Read the passage carefully and answer the questions below.
zh: 仔細閱讀這段文章，並回答下列問題。

en: All passengers must wear seat belts on this bus.
zh: 所有乘客在這輛巴士上都必須繫安全帶。

en: Amy has a passion for dancing and practices every day.
zh: 艾咪對跳舞充滿熱情，每天都練習。

en: Don't forget to bring your passport when you travel abroad.
zh: 出國旅行時別忘了帶護照。

en: The coach patted Tom on the back after the great game.
zh: 精彩的比賽結束後，教練拍了拍湯姆的背。

en: Teaching young children takes a lot of patience.
zh: 教導小孩子需要很大的耐心。

en: The speaker paused for a moment to drink some water.
zh: 演講者暫停了一下，喝點水。

en: The workers paved the road near our school last month.
zh: 工人上個月把我們學校附近的路鋪好了。

en: My little sister always pushes the peas to the side of her plate.
zh: 我妹妹總是把豌豆推到盤子的一邊。

en: Some people get very sick if they eat peanuts.
zh: 有些人吃了花生會非常不舒服。

en: Grandma gave Mom a necklace with a beautiful white pearl.
zh: 奶奶送給媽媽一條鑲著美麗白色珍珠的項鍊。

en: Please peel the apples before you cut them into pieces.
zh: 把蘋果切塊之前，請先削皮。

en: Penguins cannot fly, but they are very good swimmers.
zh: 企鵝不會飛，但牠們很會游泳。

en: The candy cost only one penny when Grandpa was young.
zh: 爺爺小時候，那種糖果只要一分錢。

en: Add a little salt and pepper to the soup.
zh: 在湯裡加一點鹽和胡椒。

en: Our class will perform a short play at the school festival.
zh: 我們班將在學校的慶祝活動上表演一齣短劇。

en: Everyone clapped loudly after her wonderful piano performance last night.
zh: 昨晚她精彩的鋼琴演出結束後，大家都熱烈鼓掌。

en: You need your parents' permission to join the school trip.
zh: 你需要父母的許可才能參加校外教學。

en: Phones are not permitted in the classroom during tests.
zh: 考試期間，教室裡不准使用手機。

en: Amy finally persuaded her parents to let her keep the puppy.
zh: 艾咪終於說服了她父母，讓她養那隻小狗。

en: The photographer took pictures of all the students on graduation day.
zh: 攝影師在畢業那天幫所有學生拍照。

en: Children were feeding the pigeons in the park.
zh: 孩子們在公園裡餵鴿子。

en: There is a pile of dirty clothes on the bedroom floor.
zh: 臥室地板上有一堆髒衣服。

en: The doctor told him to take one pill after each meal.
zh: 醫生要他每餐飯後吃一顆藥丸。

en: The pilot flew the plane safely through the storm.
zh: 飛行員駕駛飛機安全地穿越暴風雨。

en: The air smells fresh in the pine forest.
zh: 松樹林裡的空氣聞起來很清新。

en: Pineapple cake is a popular gift from Taiwan.
zh: 鳳梨酥是很受歡迎的台灣伴手禮。

en: Dad bought a pint of milk at the store on his way home.
zh: 爸爸回家途中在商店買了一品脫的牛奶。

en: The children dug a pit in the sand at the beach.
zh: 孩子們在海灘的沙子裡挖了一個坑。

en: The music teacher played a note so we could find the right pitch.
zh: 音樂老師彈了一個音，好讓我們找到正確的音高。

en: We felt pity for the lost little dog in the rain.
zh: 我們很同情那隻在雨中迷路的小狗。

en: Bring your own cup instead of using plastic ones.
zh: 自己帶杯子，不要使用塑膠杯。

en: The playful puppy kept running after its own tail.
zh: 那隻愛玩的小狗一直追著自己的尾巴跑。

en: Don't worry, we have plenty of time before the train leaves.
zh: 別擔心，火車開之前我們還有很多時間。

en: Remember to plug in your phone before you go to bed.
zh: 睡覺前記得把手機插上電。

en: The flag is flying at the top of a tall pole.
zh: 旗子在一根高高的竿子頂端飄揚。

en: Grandpa likes to read the political news in the paper every morning.
zh: 爺爺每天早上喜歡讀報紙上的政治新聞。

en: The politician promised to build a new park in our town.
zh: 那位政治人物承諾要在我們鎮上蓋一座新公園。

en: Dad and Grandpa often talk about politics at dinner.
zh: 爸爸和爺爺常在晚餐時聊政治。

en: A poll showed that most students want a longer lunch break.
zh: 一項民調顯示，大多數學生希望午休時間長一點。

en: Throwing trash into the river will pollute the water.
zh: 把垃圾丟進河裡會污染河水。

en: Air pollution in the city is worse in winter.
zh: 城市的空氣污染在冬天比較嚴重。

en: Be careful with that porcelain bowl; it breaks easily.
zh: 小心那個瓷碗，它很容易破。

en: The restaurant serves large portions, so we shared one meal.
zh: 那家餐廳份量很大，所以我們合吃一份餐。

en: A portrait of the school's first principal hangs in the hall.
zh: 學校第一任校長的肖像掛在大廳裡。

en: Amy has a poster of her favorite singer on her bedroom wall.
zh: 艾咪房間的牆上貼著她最喜歡的歌手的海報。

en: The baseball game was postponed because of the heavy rain.
zh: 棒球比賽因為大雨而延期了。

en: In art class, we made pottery and painted it ourselves.
zh: 美術課上，我們做了陶器，還自己幫它上色。

en: Mom poured hot tea into everyone's cups after dinner.
zh: 晚餐後，媽媽把熱茶倒進每個人的杯子裡。

en: Many families in the world still live in poverty.
zh: 世界上仍有許多家庭生活在貧窮中。

en: Mix the milk powder with warm water for the baby.
zh: 把奶粉和溫水混合，泡給寶寶喝。

en: Learning to cook is a practical skill for everyone.
zh: 學會做飯是每個人都用得到的實用技能。

en: These old family photos are very precious to my grandmother.
zh: 這些老家庭照片對我奶奶來說非常珍貴。

en: After weeks of preparation, the students were ready for the show.
zh: 經過幾週的準備，學生們已經可以上台演出了。

en: Your presence at the meeting is important, so please come on time.
zh: 你出席這場會議很重要，所以請準時到。

en: The boy pretended to be asleep when his mom came in.
zh: 媽媽進來時，那個男孩假裝睡著了。

en: Washing your hands often can help prevent colds and the flu.
zh: 常洗手有助於預防感冒和流感。

en: The new phone is much faster than the previous one.
zh: 新手機比之前那支快多了。

en: It is probable that it will rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
zh: 今天下午很可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。

en: Learning a new language is a slow process that takes time.
zh: 學習一種新語言是一個需要時間的緩慢過程。

en: This farm is the biggest producer of rice in the area.
zh: 這座農場是這個地區最大的稻米生產者。

en: This store sells many products made in Taiwan.
zh: 這家店販售許多台灣製造的產品。

en: Her father is a professor who teaches history at a university.
zh: 她父親是在大學教歷史的教授。

en: The class made a small profit by selling cookies at the fair.
zh: 全班在園遊會上賣餅乾，賺了一點利潤。

en: The school holds events to promote healthy eating among students.
zh: 學校舉辦活動，在學生之間推廣健康飲食。

en: Can you tell me how to pronounce this word?
zh: 你可以告訴我這個字怎麼發音嗎？

en: Do you have any proof that you finished your homework?
zh: 你有任何證據證明你寫完功課了嗎？

en: Please don't touch the bikes; they are school property.
zh: 請不要碰那些腳踏車，它們是學校的財產。

en: Wear sunglasses for protection from the strong summer sun.
zh: 戴上太陽眼鏡，保護眼睛不受夏天強烈陽光傷害。

en: We had lunch at a small pub during our trip to England.
zh: 我們去英國旅行時，在一家小酒吧吃了午餐。

en: Tom used a pump to fill the basketball with air.
zh: 湯姆用打氣筒幫籃球打氣。

en: He punched the air with joy when his team scored.
zh: 他的隊伍得分時，他高興得朝空中揮拳。

en: The children laughed at the funny puppet show.
zh: 孩子們看著好笑的木偶戲哈哈大笑。

en: The water from this mountain spring is very pure.
zh: 這座山泉的水非常純淨。

en: She took some money out of her purse to pay for lunch.
zh: 她從錢包裡拿出一些錢付午餐費。

en: There was a queer smell coming from the old box.
zh: 那個舊箱子散發出一股古怪的味道。

en: Dad quit smoking last year for his health.
zh: 爸爸為了健康，去年戒菸了。

en: Our teacher likes to quote famous people in her lessons.
zh: 我們老師上課時喜歡引用名人說過的話。

en: The teacher told us that racial jokes can hurt people's feelings.
zh: 老師告訴我們，種族笑話會傷害別人的感情。

en: He cleaned the dirty window with an old rag.
zh: 他用一塊舊破布擦髒窗戶。

en: Our school ranks first in the city for basketball.
zh: 我們學校的籃球在全市排名第一。

en: The birth rate in Taiwan has been falling for years.
zh: 台灣的出生率多年來一直在下降。

en: Don't eat raw chicken because it can make you sick.
zh: 不要吃生雞肉，因為它會讓你生病。

en: The first rays of sunlight came through the window.
zh: 第一道陽光從窗戶照了進來。

en: Dad uses a razor every morning to keep his face smooth.
zh: 爸爸每天早上用刮鬍刀讓臉保持光滑。

en: How did your mom react when she saw your test score?
zh: 你媽媽看到你的考試成績時，有什麼反應？

en: Her first reaction to the news was a big smile.
zh: 她聽到這個消息的第一個反應是露出大大的笑容。

en: The price of the shoes was reasonable, so I bought them.
zh: 那雙鞋的價格很合理，所以我買了。

en: Please keep your receipt in case you want to return the shirt.
zh: 請保留收據，以防你想退還這件襯衫。

en: The receiver of the letter will get it in three days.
zh: 收信人三天內就會收到這封信。

en: I didn't recognize Amy at first because of her new haircut.
zh: 因為艾咪剪了新髮型，我一開始沒認出她。

en: Tom used a small recorder to record the speech contest.
zh: 湯姆用一台小錄音機錄下演講比賽。

en: A door is usually shaped like a rectangle.
zh: 門通常是長方形的。

en: Turning off lights can reduce the amount of electricity we use.
zh: 隨手關燈可以減少我們的用電量。

en: Our school team won the regional basketball contest last week.
zh: 我們校隊上週贏得區域籃球比賽。

en: Tom regrets not studying harder for the final exam.
zh: 湯姆後悔期末考前沒有更用功讀書。

en: Listening to soft music helps me relax after a long day.
zh: 忙了一整天後，聽輕柔的音樂能幫助我放鬆。

en: The children released the small turtle back into the sea.
zh: 孩子們把那隻小海龜放回大海。

en: Amy is a reliable friend who always keeps her promises.
zh: 艾咪是個可靠的朋友，總是信守承諾。

en: It was a great relief to find my lost phone.
zh: 找到弄丟的手機，讓我大大鬆了一口氣。

en: Many religious people visit the temple during the holidays.
zh: 很多有宗教信仰的人會在假期時到那間廟參拜。

en: Many students rely on their phones to check the bus time.
zh: 許多學生依賴手機查公車時間。

en: Please remain in your seats until the bell rings.
zh: 鐘響之前，請留在你們的座位上。

en: Please remind me to call Grandma when we get home tonight.
zh: 今晚我們到家時，請提醒我打電話給奶奶。

en: Grandpa lives in a remote village high in the mountains.
zh: 爺爺住在高山上一個偏僻的村莊。

en: We need to replace the broken window in the classroom.
zh: 我們需要更換教室裡破掉的窗戶。

en: Tom will represent our class in the speech contest.
zh: 湯姆將代表我們班參加演講比賽。

en: Each class chose one representative to join the student meeting.
zh: 每個班級選出一位代表參加學生會議。

en: France became a republic more than two hundred years ago.
zh: 法國在兩百多年前成為共和國。

en: The teacher agreed to our request for less homework.
zh: 老師同意了我們減少作業的請求。

en: We reserved a table for six at the restaurant.
zh: 我們在餐廳預訂了一張六人桌。

en: It is hard to resist a piece of chocolate cake.
zh: 一塊巧克力蛋糕實在讓人很難抗拒。

en: Water is an important resource, so don't waste it.
zh: 水是重要的資源，所以不要浪費。

en: Tom sent Amy a message, but he got no response.
zh: 湯姆傳了訊息給艾咪，但沒有得到回應。

en: Taking care of the family dog is my responsibility.
zh: 照顧家裡的狗是我的責任。

en: Some parents restrict how much time their kids spend on phones.
zh: 有些父母會限制孩子使用手機的時間。

en: Amy finally revealed the secret she had kept for weeks.
zh: 艾咪終於揭露了她守了好幾個星期的秘密。

en: She tied a red ribbon around the birthday present.
zh: 她在生日禮物上綁了一條紅色緞帶。

en: We need to get rid of these old toys we never use.
zh: 我們得把這些從來不玩的舊玩具處理掉。

en: These bananas are not ripe yet; they are still green.
zh: 這些香蕉還沒成熟，它們還是綠色的。

en: Swimming alone in the sea is a big risk.
zh: 獨自在海裡游泳是很大的風險。

en: We heard the lion roar loudly at the zoo.
zh: 我們在動物園聽到獅子大聲吼叫。

en: We roasted sweet potatoes over the fire at the camp.
zh: 我們在營地用火烤地瓜。

en: Two men tried to rob the store, but the police caught them.
zh: 兩名男子企圖搶劫那家店，但被警察抓到了。

en: There was a robbery at the store near our school last night.
zh: 昨晚我們學校附近的商店發生了一起搶案。

en: After his bath, Grandpa put on a warm robe.
zh: 洗完澡後，爺爺穿上一件保暖的長袍。

en: The rocket flew into space with a loud noise.
zh: 火箭發出巨大的聲響飛向太空。

en: The old town looks romantic at night with its soft lights.
zh: 夜晚在柔和的燈光下，這座古鎮看起來很浪漫。

en: The apples will rot if you leave them in the sun.
zh: 如果把蘋果放在太陽下，它們會腐爛。

en: This egg smells bad; it must be rotten.
zh: 這顆蛋聞起來很臭，一定是腐壞了。

en: The old wooden table feels rough, so be careful of your hands.
zh: 那張舊木桌摸起來很粗糙，所以小心你的手。

en: It takes roughly twenty minutes to walk to school.
zh: 走路去學校大約要二十分鐘。

en: Brushing my teeth before bed is part of my daily routine.
zh: 睡前刷牙是我每天例行公事的一部分。

en: The cat likes to sleep on the soft rug by the sofa.
zh: 貓喜歡睡在沙發旁柔軟的小地毯上。

en: Don't believe every rumor you hear on the internet.
zh: 不要相信你在網路上聽到的每一個謠言。

en: Tom rushed to the bus stop because he got up late.
zh: 湯姆因為起晚了，急忙衝到公車站。

en: The old bike was left in the rain and covered with rust.
zh: 那台舊腳踏車被放在雨中，長滿了鏽。

en: The farmer carried a heavy sack of rice on his back.
zh: 農夫背著一大袋沉重的米。

en: Please turn down the music for your little brother's sake.
zh: 為了你弟弟著想，請把音樂關小聲一點。

en: Her first job paid a small salary, but she enjoyed it.
zh: 她的第一份工作薪水不高，但她很喜歡。

en: The test results were satisfactory, so the teacher let us go home early.
zh: 考試結果令人滿意，所以老師讓我們提早回家。

en: Grandma makes a sweet sauce for the chicken every New Year.
zh: 每年過年，奶奶都會為雞肉做一種甜甜的醬汁。

en: Please put the teacup on the saucer so it won't wet the table.
zh: 請把茶杯放在茶碟上，才不會把桌子弄濕。

en: At the night market, Tom bought a hot sausage for his little sister.
zh: 在夜市，湯姆買了一根熱騰騰的香腸給他妹妹。

en: Amy used all her savings to buy a new bike for school.
zh: 艾咪用她所有的存款買了一輛上學用的新腳踏車。

en: The school sports day this year was on a much larger scale.
zh: 今年學校運動會的規模大了許多。

en: Water becomes scarce in the south when it doesn't rain for months.
zh: 好幾個月不下雨時，南部的水就變得稀少。

en: It was very cold, so Dad wore a thick scarf around his neck.
zh: 天氣很冷，所以爸爸在脖子上圍了一條厚圍巾。

en: The movie was so scary that my brother hid behind the sofa.
zh: 這部電影太可怕了，我弟弟躲到沙發後面。

en: The wind blew the papers off the desk and scattered them across the floor.
zh: 風把紙從桌上吹落，散布在地板各處。

en: The old scholar has spent forty years studying Chinese history.
zh: 這位老學者花了四十年研究中國歷史。

en: She won a scholarship because her grades were the best in her class.
zh: 她因為成績是全班最好的而獲得獎學金。

en: Doctors look for scientific reasons why some people get sick more easily.
zh: 醫生尋找某些人比較容易生病的科學原因。

en: When she grows up, Lily wants to be a scientist who studies stars.
zh: 莉莉長大後想當一位研究星星的科學家。

en: Can I borrow your scissors to cut this paper in half?
zh: 我可以借你的剪刀把這張紙剪成兩半嗎？

en: Ben joined the scouts and learned how to build a fire outdoors.
zh: 班加入了童子軍，學會如何在戶外生火。

en: The girls screamed when they saw a big spider on the wall.
zh: 女孩們看到牆上有一隻大蜘蛛時尖叫起來。

en: Dad used a small screw to fix the broken leg of the chair.
zh: 爸爸用一顆小螺絲修好了椅子斷掉的腳。

en: After dinner, we had to scrub the dirty pots until they were clean.
zh: 晚餐後，我們得把髒鍋子擦洗到乾淨為止。

en: We watched a seal swim and play with a ball at the zoo.
zh: 我們在動物園看一隻海豹游泳並玩球。

en: For security, students must show their cards before entering the school.
zh: 為了安全，學生進入校園前必須出示學生證。

en: The new semester starts next Monday, and I'm excited to see my friends.
zh: 新學期下週一開始，我很期待見到我的朋友們。

en: The senior students are busy studying for the big exam in January.
zh: 高年級的學生正忙著準備一月的大考。

en: It is sensible to bring an umbrella when the sky looks dark.
zh: 天色看起來很暗時，帶把傘是明智的。

en: After a long separation, the two old friends finally met again.
zh: 分離了很久之後，這兩位老朋友終於再次見面。

en: The health class teaches students about sexual health and body safety.
zh: 健康課教導學生性健康與身體安全的知識。

en: Some ads use sexy models to sell clothes to young people.
zh: 有些廣告用性感的模特兒向年輕人推銷衣服。

en: In the late afternoon, our shadows on the ground became very long.
zh: 傍晚時，我們在地上的影子變得很長。

en: Young children should only swim in the shallow part of the pool.
zh: 小孩子應該只在泳池較淺的區域游泳。

en: This shampoo smells like flowers and makes my hair soft.
zh: 這瓶洗髮精聞起來有花香，讓我的頭髮很柔順。

en: The shepherd watched his sheep on the hill all day long.
zh: 牧羊人整天在山坡上看顧他的羊。

en: Grandpa gave me a shiny new coin for good luck.
zh: 爺爺給我一枚閃亮的新硬幣，祝我好運。

en: The coach decided to shorten practice because of the heavy rain.
zh: 因為下大雨，教練決定縮短練習時間。

en: The train will arrive shortly, so please stand behind the yellow line.
zh: 火車不久就會到站，請站在黃線後面。

en: The kids used a small shovel to dig a hole in the sand.
zh: 孩子們用一把小鏟子在沙子裡挖洞。

en: We ordered fried rice with shrimp at the restaurant last night.
zh: 我們昨晚在餐廳點了蝦仁炒飯。

en: My favorite T-shirt shrank after I washed it in hot water.
zh: 我最喜歡的T恤用熱水洗過後縮水了。

en: Mom gave a long sigh when she saw my messy room.
zh: 媽媽看到我凌亂的房間時，長長地嘆了一口氣。

en: There is no phone signal in the mountains, so we couldn't call home.
zh: 山裡沒有手機訊號，所以我們無法打電話回家。

en: Exercising every day can make a significant difference to your health.
zh: 每天運動可以為你的健康帶來顯著的改變。

en: This dress is made of silk, so it feels smooth and soft.
zh: 這件洋裝是絲做的，所以摸起來光滑柔軟。

en: People often notice the similarity between Tom and his father.
zh: 人們常注意到湯姆和他爸爸之間的相似處。

en: In the old story, the man believed that lying was a sin.
zh: 在那個古老的故事裡，那個人相信說謊是一種罪。

en: Please accept my sincere thanks for helping me with my homework.
zh: 請接受我真誠的謝意，謝謝你幫我做功課。

en: After dinner, Dad washed all the dishes in the kitchen sink.
zh: 晚餐後，爸爸在廚房的水槽裡洗完所有碗盤。

en: Grandpa took a sip of hot tea and smiled at us.
zh: 爺爺啜飲了一口熱茶，對我們微笑。

en: If you are in a dangerous situation, call the police right away.
zh: 如果你身處危險的情況，要立刻報警。

en: Ben learned to skate when he was only five years old.
zh: 班五歲時就學會了溜冰。

en: We went to Japan last winter to ski in the snowy mountains.
zh: 我們去年冬天去日本，在雪山上滑雪。

en: The skillful cook made dumplings very quickly with his hands.
zh: 那位熟練的廚師用雙手很快地包好了水餃。

en: The boy is so skinny that his pants keep falling down.
zh: 那個男孩瘦到褲子一直往下掉。

en: Don't skip breakfast, or you will feel hungry during class.
zh: 別省略早餐，否則上課時你會肚子餓。

en: In the past, many slaves had to work on farms without pay.
zh: 在過去，許多奴隸必須在農場工作，卻領不到工資。

en: It's hot today, so I'm wearing a shirt with short sleeves.
zh: 今天很熱，所以我穿了一件短袖襯衫。

en: The dancer is tall and slender, with long arms and legs.
zh: 那位舞者高挑苗條，手腳修長。

en: Would you like another slice of cake with your tea?
zh: 你想再來一片蛋糕配茶嗎？

en: Be careful! The floor is slippery after the rain.
zh: 小心！下過雨後地板很滑。

en: We pushed our bikes up the long slope to the top of the hill.
zh: 我們把腳踏車推上長長的斜坡，到達山頂。

en: The dry branch snapped when Tom stepped on it.
zh: 湯姆一踩，那根乾樹枝就啪地一聲折斷了。

en: Ice is water in solid form, so you can hold it in your hand.
zh: 冰是固體狀態的水，所以你可以把它拿在手上。

en: Someday I hope to travel around the world with my best friend.
zh: 我希望將來有一天能和我最好的朋友環遊世界。

en: Somehow the cat got into the locked room, and nobody knows how.
zh: 不知怎麼地，貓跑進了上鎖的房間，沒有人知道是怎麼回事。

en: Let's meet for lunch sometime next week when we are both free.
zh: 下週找個我們都有空的時間，一起吃午餐吧。

en: The whole family felt deep sorrow when their old dog died.
zh: 他們家的老狗死去時，全家人都感到深深的悲傷。

en: For dinner, Mom cooked spaghetti with tomato sauce and cheese.
zh: 晚餐媽媽煮了加番茄醬汁和起司的義大利麵。

en: Can you give me a specific time to meet, like three o'clock?
zh: 你能給我一個具體的見面時間嗎？例如三點。

en: Indian food often uses many spices, so it smells very strong.
zh: 印度菜常使用許多香料，所以味道聞起來很濃。

en: Be careful not to spill your milk on the new carpet.
zh: 小心別把牛奶灑在新地毯上。

en: The little girl likes to spin around until she feels dizzy.
zh: 那個小女孩喜歡一直轉圈，直到頭暈為止。

en: Eat your spinach, because green vegetables help keep you healthy.
zh: 把你的菠菜吃掉，因為綠色蔬菜能幫助你保持健康。

en: Please don't spit on the ground; it's dirty and rude.
zh: 請不要在地上吐口水，那既髒又沒禮貌。

en: He broke his sister's toy out of spite because she laughed at him.
zh: 他出於惡意弄壞了妹妹的玩具，因為她嘲笑了他。

en: The kids splashed water on each other in the swimming pool.
zh: 孩子們在游泳池裡互相潑水。

en: Grandparents sometimes spoil their grandchildren by giving them too much candy.
zh: 祖父母有時會給孫子太多糖果，把他們寵壞。

en: Dad sprays water on the plants every morning before work.
zh: 爸爸每天早上上班前都會在植物上噴水。

en: In the movie, the spy secretly took photos of the enemy's plans.
zh: 在電影裡，那個間諜偷偷拍下了敵人的計畫。

en: Mom squeezed some oranges to make fresh juice for breakfast.
zh: 媽媽擠了幾顆柳橙，做新鮮果汁當早餐。

en: A squirrel ran up the tree with a nut in its mouth.
zh: 一隻松鼠嘴裡叼著堅果，跑上了樹。

en: After a week in the hospital, Grandpa's health is now stable.
zh: 在醫院待了一週後，爺爺的健康狀況現在很穩定。

en: Thousands of fans filled the stadium to watch the baseball game.
zh: 數千名球迷擠滿了體育場觀看棒球比賽。

en: The hotel staff were very friendly and helped us carry our bags.
zh: 飯店的員工非常友善，還幫我們提行李。

en: This bread is stale because we left it out for three days.
zh: 這麵包不新鮮了，因為我們把它放在外面三天。

en: It is not polite to stare at people on the bus.
zh: 在公車上盯著別人看是不禮貌的。

en: Many animals starve in winter when they cannot find food.
zh: 許多動物在冬天找不到食物時會挨餓。

en: There is a large statue of a famous writer in the park.
zh: 公園裡有一座知名作家的大雕像。

en: Please keep your hands steady when you take the photo.
zh: 拍照時請讓你的手保持穩定。

en: Someone stole my bike while I was in the library.
zh: 我在圖書館時，有人偷了我的腳踏車。

en: Steam rose from the hot soup as Grandma brought it to the table.
zh: 奶奶把熱湯端上桌時，湯冒出了蒸氣。

en: The road up the mountain was so steep that we had to walk slowly.
zh: 上山的路太陡峭了，我們只好慢慢走。

en: My fingers were sticky after I ate the honey cake.
zh: 我吃完蜂蜜蛋糕後，手指黏黏的。

en: After sitting at the desk all day, my neck felt stiff.
zh: 在書桌前坐了一整天後，我的脖子覺得很僵硬。

en: A bee stung Amy on the arm, and it hurt a lot.
zh: 一隻蜜蜂螫了艾咪的手臂，非常痛。

en: Stir the soup slowly so it doesn't burn at the bottom.
zh: 慢慢攪拌湯，鍋底才不會燒焦。

en: Grandma used a needle to stitch the hole in my sock.
zh: 奶奶用針把我襪子上的破洞縫好。

en: I ate too much fried chicken, and now my stomach hurts.
zh: 我吃了太多炸雞，現在胃好痛。

en: Tom stood on a stool to reach the top shelf.
zh: 湯姆站在凳子上，才搆得到最上層的架子。

en: The flight was canceled because of the stormy weather.
zh: 因為暴風雨的天氣，班機被取消了。

en: Don't touch the stove; it is still very hot.
zh: 別碰爐子，它還很燙。

en: Our team needs a new strategy to win the next basketball game.
zh: 我們隊需要一個新策略來贏得下一場籃球賽。

en: Can I have a straw for my bubble tea, please?
zh: 可以給我一根喝珍珠奶茶的吸管嗎？

en: Lifting heavy boxes takes a lot of strength.
zh: 搬重箱子需要很大的力氣。

en: Cut the paper into long strips and glue them together.
zh: 把紙剪成長條，再把它們黏在一起。

en: The teacher explained the structure of the human body in science class.
zh: 老師在自然課上講解人體的結構。

en: My little brother is so stubborn that he never says sorry first.
zh: 我弟弟非常固執，從來不會先道歉。

en: The singer recorded her new song in a small studio.
zh: 那位歌手在一間小錄音室錄製她的新歌。

en: Please put your stuff in the box before you leave the room.
zh: 離開房間前，請把你的東西放進箱子裡。

en: Water is the most important substance for all living things.
zh: 水是所有生物最重要的物質。

en: If you subtract three from ten, you get seven.
zh: 如果十減去三，就得到七。

en: They moved to a quiet suburb outside of Taipei last year.
zh: 他們去年搬到台北外圍一個安靜的郊區。

en: The little boy sucked the juice through a long straw.
zh: 那個小男孩用長吸管吸果汁。

en: Many people suffer from colds when the weather suddenly changes.
zh: 天氣突然變化時，很多人會受感冒所苦。

en: We don't have sufficient time to finish the project today.
zh: 我們今天沒有足夠的時間完成這個專題。

en: If a friend talks about suicide, tell a teacher or adult right away.
zh: 如果有朋友談到自殺，要立刻告訴老師或大人。

en: The sum of five and seven is twelve.
zh: 五加七的總和是十二。

en: Please write a short summary of the story in your own words.
zh: 請用你自己的話為這個故事寫一篇簡短的摘要。

en: After climbing for five hours, we finally reached the summit of the mountain.
zh: 爬了五個小時後，我們終於抵達山頂。

en: This new phone is superior to the old one in many ways.
zh: 這支新手機在許多方面都比舊的好。

en: Tall mountains surround the small village on all sides.
zh: 高山從四面八方包圍著這座小村莊。

en: The school did a survey to find out students' favorite lunches.
zh: 學校做了一項調查，了解學生最喜歡的午餐。

en: The only survivor of the boat accident was a young fisherman.
zh: 這場船難唯一的倖存者是一位年輕的漁夫。

en: I suspect that my brother ate the last piece of cake.
zh: 我懷疑是我弟弟吃了最後一塊蛋糕。

en: The teacher had a suspicion that some students copied each other's homework.
zh: 老師懷疑有些學生互相抄作業。

en: A white swan swam slowly across the quiet lake.
zh: 一隻白天鵝慢慢地游過平靜的湖面。

en: Ben swore that he did not break the window.
zh: 班發誓他沒有打破窗戶。

en: After the basketball game, Tom's shirt was wet with sweat.
zh: 籃球比賽結束後，湯姆的上衣被汗水浸濕了。

en: Her foot began to swell after she hurt it during the race.
zh: 她在賽跑中受傷後，腳開始腫起來。

en: The swift runner passed everyone and won the race easily.
zh: 那位跑得飛快的選手超越所有人，輕鬆贏得比賽。

en: In the old story, the king gave the young hero a magic sword.
zh: 在那個古老的故事裡，國王給了年輕的英雄一把魔法劍。

en: The doctor told me to take one tablet after each meal.
zh: 醫生要我每餐飯後吃一顆藥片。

en: Look at the price tag before you buy the jacket.
zh: 買外套之前，先看一下價格標籤。

en: The tailor made the pants shorter so they would fit me.
zh: 裁縫師把褲子改短，好讓它合我的身。

en: Lisa has a real talent for music and plays the piano beautifully.
zh: 麗莎很有音樂天分，鋼琴彈得很優美。

en: Our new classmate is very talkative and makes friends easily.
zh: 我們的新同學很愛說話，很容易交到朋友。

en: The deer in the park are so tame that they eat from your hand.
zh: 公園裡的鹿非常溫馴，會直接從你手上吃東西。

en: Grandma gave each of us a sweet tangerine after lunch.
zh: 午餐後，奶奶給我們每人一顆甜甜的橘子。

en: We keep three small goldfish in a glass tank in the living room.
zh: 我們在客廳的玻璃缸裡養了三隻小金魚。

en: Someone tapped me on the shoulder during the movie.
zh: 看電影時，有人輕拍了我的肩膀。

en: The beef noodles at this small shop are cheap and tasty.
zh: 這家小店的牛肉麵又便宜又美味。

en: Please don't tease your sister about her new haircut.
zh: 請不要取笑你妹妹的新髮型。

en: The game stopped for ten minutes because of a technical problem.
zh: 比賽因為技術問題暫停了十分鐘。

en: The coach showed us a new technique for kicking the ball.
zh: 教練教我們一種新的踢球技巧。

en: Many teenage students spend too much time on their phones.
zh: 許多青少年學生花太多時間在手機上。

en: Dad has a bad temper when he is tired and hungry.
zh: 爸爸又累又餓的時候脾氣很差。

en: Amy found a temporary job at a coffee shop for the summer.
zh: 艾咪找到一份在咖啡店的暑期臨時工作。

en: Teenagers tend to stay up late and sleep in on weekends.
zh: 青少年週末往往會熬夜和睡懶覺。

en: Mom spoke in a tender voice to the crying baby.
zh: 媽媽用溫柔的聲音對哭泣的寶寶說話。

en: We put up a tent by the river and camped there for the night.
zh: 我們在河邊搭起帳篷，在那裡露營過夜。

en: You did a terrific job on your science report!
zh: 你的自然科報告做得太棒了！

en: The dog barks at anyone who walks into its territory.
zh: 那隻狗會對走進牠地盤的任何人吠叫。

en: We are thankful to our teachers for all their help this year.
zh: 我們很感謝老師們今年給我們的所有幫助。

en: The scientist has a new theory about why dinosaurs died out.
zh: 那位科學家對恐龍為何滅絕提出了一個新理論。

en: Lost in the desert, the man almost died of thirst.
zh: 迷失在沙漠中，那個人差點渴死。

en: Grandma needs her glasses to put the thread through the needle.
zh: 奶奶需要戴眼鏡才能把線穿過針。

en: Heavy rain is a big threat to the farmers' crops this year.
zh: 今年的大雨對農民的作物是一大威脅。

en: The older boy threatened to tell the teacher if we didn't stop.
zh: 那個大男孩威脅說，如果我們不停下來，他就要告訴老師。

en: Amy hurt her thumb when she closed the door on it.
zh: 艾咪關門時夾傷了大拇指。

en: At low tide, we can walk on the beach and find small crabs.
zh: 退潮時，我們可以在海灘上散步，找小螃蟹。

en: These shoes are too tight, so my feet hurt when I walk.
zh: 這雙鞋太緊了，所以我走路時腳會痛。

en: Please tighten your seat belt before the car starts moving.
zh: 車子開動前，請繫緊你的安全帶。

en: The old house was built with timber from the nearby forest.
zh: 這棟老房子是用附近森林的木材建造的。

en: Tobacco is bad for your health, so you should never start smoking.
zh: 菸草對健康有害，所以你千萬不要開始抽菸。

en: The big truck can carry more than ten tons of rice.
zh: 這輛大卡車可以載超過十噸的米。

en: Tom tossed the ball to his dog, and it ran to catch it.
zh: 湯姆把球拋給他的狗，狗就跑去接。

en: The math test was so tough that only a few students passed.
zh: 這次數學考試很難，只有少數學生及格。

en: Tourism brings a lot of money to small towns near the sea.
zh: 觀光業為海邊的小鎮帶來大量收入。

en: Many tourists visit the night markets in Taipei every year.
zh: 每年都有許多觀光客造訪台北的夜市。

en: Our car broke down, so a truck had to tow it away.
zh: 我們的車拋錨了，只好請一輛卡車把它拖走。

en: From the top of the tower, we could see the whole city.
zh: 從塔頂上，我們可以看到整座城市。

en: The thief left no trace, so the police could not find him.
zh: 小偷沒有留下任何痕跡，所以警察找不到他。

en: The trader bought tea in Taiwan and sold it in Europe.
zh: 那位商人在台灣買茶，然後拿到歐洲賣。

en: We followed a narrow trail up the hill to see the sunset.
zh: 我們沿著一條狹窄的小徑上山看夕陽。

en: Trains are a cheap and fast way to transport people between cities.
zh: 火車是在城市之間運送旅客既便宜又快速的方式。

en: The traveler asked us how to get to the train station.
zh: 那位旅行者問我們怎麼去火車站。

en: The waiter carried four cups of coffee on a small tray.
zh: 服務生用一個小托盤端著四杯咖啡。

en: Wearing big, loose T-shirts is a popular trend among students now.
zh: 穿寬大的T恤是現在學生之間流行的趨勢。

en: The tribe has lived in these mountains for hundreds of years.
zh: 這個部落已經在這些山裡住了好幾百年。

en: The last question on the test was tricky, and many students got it wrong.
zh: 考卷上最後一題很棘手，很多學生都答錯了。

en: A troop of monkeys came down from the hill looking for food.
zh: 一群猴子從山上下來找食物。

en: Taiwan grows many tropical fruits, like mangoes and bananas.
zh: 台灣種植許多熱帶水果，像是芒果和香蕉。

en: Jack plays the trumpet in the school band.
zh: 傑克在學校樂隊裡吹小號。

en: Dad put our bags in the trunk of the car.
zh: 爸爸把我們的包包放進汽車的後車廂。

en: Please be truthful and tell me what really happened.
zh: 請誠實地告訴我到底發生了什麼事。

en: The little boy played with his toy boat in the tub.
zh: 小男孩在浴缸裡玩他的玩具船。

en: The puppy tugged at my shoe because it wanted to play.
zh: 小狗用力拉扯我的鞋子，因為牠想玩。

en: Amy sang a happy tune as she walked to school.
zh: 艾咪走路上學時，唱著一首輕快的曲子。

en: The train went through a long tunnel under the mountain.
zh: 火車穿過山底下一條長長的隧道。

en: Tom's parents hired a math tutor to help him before the exam.
zh: 湯姆的爸媽在考試前請了一位數學家教來幫他。

en: Amy and her twin sister look so alike that people often mix them up.
zh: 艾咪和她的雙胞胎妹妹長得好像，大家常把她們搞混。

en: Twist the cap to the left to open the bottle.
zh: 把瓶蓋往左扭轉就能打開瓶子。

en: The underlying reason for his bad grades was a lack of sleep.
zh: 他成績差的根本原因是睡眠不足。

en: Remember to pack enough clean underwear for the five-day trip.
zh: 記得為五天的旅行帶足夠的乾淨內衣褲。

en: The workers joined a union to ask for better pay.
zh: 工人們加入工會，爭取更好的待遇。

en: Her singing style is unique, and nobody else sounds like her.
zh: 她的唱歌風格很獨特，沒有人聽起來像她。

en: The whole school united to help the family after the fire.
zh: 火災過後，全校團結起來幫助那個家庭。

en: Our team won because of its unity and hard work.
zh: 我們隊能獲勝，靠的是團結和努力。

en: More and more people are moving from the countryside to urban areas.
zh: 越來越多人從鄉下搬到都市地區。

en: Is this seat vacant, or is someone sitting here?
zh: 這個座位是空的嗎？還是有人坐？

en: The whole team rode to the game in a big white van.
zh: 全隊搭一輛白色大廂型車去比賽。

en: The sun vanished behind the dark clouds, and it began to rain.
zh: 太陽消失在烏雲後面，接著開始下雨了。

en: The night market offers a wide variety of snacks and drinks.
zh: 夜市提供各式各樣的小吃和飲料。

en: Students can join various clubs, such as music, art, and sports.
zh: 學生可以參加各種社團，例如音樂、美術和運動社團。

en: Prices of fruit vary from season to season.
zh: 水果的價格隨季節而變化。

en: Mom put the fresh flowers in a glass vase on the table.
zh: 媽媽把鮮花插在桌上的玻璃花瓶裡。

en: No vehicles are allowed on this street during the night market.
zh: 夜市期間，這條街禁止車輛進入。

en: We had to learn the first verse of the poem by heart.
zh: 我們必須背熟這首詩的第一段詩句。

en: It's a little cold, so wear a vest over your shirt.
zh: 天氣有點冷，在襯衫外面加件背心吧。

en: The victims of the flood needed food, water, and a safe place to sleep.
zh: 這場水災的受害者需要食物、水和安全的睡覺地方。

en: Parents should not let young children watch movies full of violence.
zh: 父母不應該讓年幼的孩子看充滿暴力的電影。

en: Some video games are too violent for young children to play.
zh: 有些電玩遊戲太暴力了，不適合小孩子玩。

en: She painted her bedroom walls a soft violet color.
zh: 她把臥室的牆漆成柔和的紫羅蘭色。

en: On a clear night, many stars are visible in the sky.
zh: 在晴朗的夜晚，天空中可以看見許多星星。

en: Reading in bad light for hours can hurt your vision.
zh: 在光線不好的地方長時間閱讀會傷害你的視力。

en: Oranges are full of vitamin C, which helps you stay healthy.
zh: 柳橙富含維他命C，能幫助你保持健康。

en: Amy still has a vivid memory of her first day at school.
zh: 艾咪對她上學的第一天仍然記憶鮮明。

en: Reading English books every day can help you build your vocabulary.
zh: 每天閱讀英文書能幫助你增加字彙量。

en: The girls play volleyball on the beach every Saturday afternoon.
zh: 女孩們每個星期六下午都在海灘打排球。

en: Please turn down the volume of the TV; the baby is sleeping.
zh: 請把電視的音量調小，寶寶正在睡覺。

en: When we chose our class leader, every voter wrote one name on paper.
zh: 我們選班長時，每位投票者都在紙上寫下一個名字。

en: Amy's part-time job pays a low wage, but she enjoys it.
zh: 艾咪打工的工資很低，但她很喜歡這份工作。

en: The horse pulled a wagon full of fruit to the market.
zh: 那匹馬拉著一輛裝滿水果的貨車到市場去。

en: We wandered around the old streets and looked at the small shops.
zh: 我們在老街上四處漫步，逛著一間間小店。

en: We sat near the fire and enjoyed its warmth on the cold night.
zh: 在寒冷的夜晚，我們坐在火堆旁，享受它的溫暖。

en: The teacher warned us not to swim in the river after heavy rain.
zh: 老師警告我們大雨過後不要在河裡游泳。

en: We walked for two hours to see the tall waterfall in the mountains.
zh: 我們走了兩個小時，去看山裡那座高高的瀑布。

en: The candle is made of wax, so keep it away from heat.
zh: 這根蠟燭是用蠟做的，所以要讓它遠離高溫。

en: Too little sleep can weaken your body and make you sick.
zh: 睡眠太少會削弱你的身體，讓你生病。

en: The wealthy man gave a lot of money to help poor children.
zh: 那位富有的男子捐了很多錢幫助貧窮的孩子。

en: In the museum, we saw old weapons used by soldiers long ago.
zh: 在博物館裡，我們看到很久以前士兵用過的古老武器。

en: The women in the village weave baskets from long grass.
zh: 村子裡的婦女用長草編織籃子。

en: A spider spent the night making a web in the corner of the window.
zh: 一隻蜘蛛花了一整夜在窗戶角落結網。

en: The couple will wed next spring in a small church.
zh: 這對情侶將在明年春天於一間小教堂結婚。

en: On Sunday, we helped Grandpa pull the weeds in his garden.
zh: 星期天，我們幫爺爺拔他菜園裡的雜草。

en: Our class has a weekly spelling test on Friday mornings.
zh: 我們班每週五早上都有一次拼字小考。

en: The girl began to weep when she lost her little dog.
zh: 那個女孩弄丟了她的小狗，開始哭泣。

en: Bread and noodles are both made from wheat.
zh: 麵包和麵條都是用小麥做的。

en: The rider used a whip to make the horse run faster.
zh: 騎士用鞭子讓馬跑得更快。

en: The coach blew his whistle, and the players stopped running.
zh: 教練吹了哨子，球員們就停止奔跑。

en: In the story, the wicked witch put the princess to sleep.
zh: 在故事裡，邪惡的巫婆讓公主陷入沉睡。

en: The city will widen the narrow road so more cars can pass.
zh: 市政府將拓寬這條窄路，讓更多車子能通過。

en: Please wipe the table with a wet cloth after dinner.
zh: 晚餐後請用濕布擦拭桌子。

en: Grandpa's wisdom comes from many years of hard life experience.
zh: 爺爺的智慧來自多年艱辛的人生經驗。

en: We wrapped Mom's birthday present in colorful paper.
zh: 我們用彩色的紙包裝媽媽的生日禮物。

en: Ben wears a watch on his left wrist.
zh: 班把手錶戴在左手腕上。

en: Our school's yearly sports day is always held in November.
zh: 我們學校每年一度的運動會總是在十一月舉行。

en: Mom yelled at us to come inside because dinner was ready.
zh: 媽媽大喊叫我們進屋，因為晚餐準備好了。

en: Some people only eat the egg white and leave the yolk.
zh: 有些人只吃蛋白，把蛋黃留下來。

en: The old man enjoys telling stories to the youngsters in the park.
zh: 那位老先生喜歡對公園裡的年輕人講故事。

en: The zipper on my jacket is broken, so I can't close it.
zh: 我外套上的拉鍊壞了，所以我拉不起來。

en: This area near the school is a no-smoking zone.
zh: 學校附近的這個區域是禁菸區。
